cartridges.title: James Pond Collection
cartridges.description: Join aquatic agent James Pond in four classic 16-bit romps for Evercade, including James Pond: Underwater Agent, James Pond 2 – Codename: RoboCod, James Pond 3: Operation StarFI5H and The Aquatic Games Starring James Pond and the Aquabats!

games.title: James Pond: Underwater Agent
games.description: Agent Double Bubble Seven is ready for action! Dive beneath the waves and take on the dastardly Dr. Maybe in this environmentally friendly action game for Evercade.

games.title: James Pond 2 - Codename: RoboCod
games.description: Armed with his new Robosuit, James Pond leaps back into action to rescue Santa's toy factories from Dr. Maybe in this colourful 16-bit platformer for Evercade.

games.title: James Pond 3: Operation StarFI5H
games.description: Blast off on a lunar adventure! James Pond races to thwart Dr. Maybe's plans to mine the Moon's cheese in this sprawling 16-bit platformer for Evercade.

games.title: The Aquatic Games
games.description: Even the world's greatest underwater agent needs some downtime. Join James Pond and the Aquabats for 10 crazy events in this cartoony multi-sports title for Evercade.

cartridges.title: The Last Ninja and IK Collection
cartridges.description: Featuring some of the most beloved home computer games of all time, The Last Ninja & IK Collection for Evercade brings you multiple versions of the martial arts classics in the Last Ninja and International Karate series.

games.title: The Last Ninja
games.description: Take command of Armakuni the last ninja as he seeks to avenge the assassination of his clan. This is the original 8-bit release of The Last Ninja, now on Evercade.

games.title: Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance (ZX)
games.description: Armakuni comes to modern-day New York in this all-action sequel. Enjoy the version of the game as released on a popular British home computer with Evercade.

games.title: Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance (C64)
games.description: Hit the streets of New York as Armakuni the ninja in the most popular 8-bit version of this spectacular sequel, now on Evercade.

games.title: Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance (ST)
games.description: Test your martial arts and adventuring skills at this 16-bit version of Armakuni's modern-day adventure, now available for Evercade.

games.title: Last Ninja 3 (C64)
games.description: Armakuni has chased the evil Kunitoki through time, and the final confrontation awaits. Enjoy the original 8-bit version of this all-time classic on Evercade.

games.title: Last Ninja 3 (ST)
games.description: Battle through the elemental chambers of the Buddhist temples in the 16-bit version of The Last Ninja's grand finale, now on Evercade.

games.title: Ninja Remix (C64)
games.description: Take to the streets of New York once more in this remixed version of Armakuni's modern-day adventure. This version was originally released for a popular 8-bit home computer.

games.title: Ninja Remix (ST)
games.description: The 16-bit version of Ninja Remix reimagines the first The Last Ninja game rather than the second. Challenge this martial arts classic on Evercade!

games.title: International Karate (ZX)
games.description: Take on the original version of this one-on-one fighting classic, as originally released on a popular 8-bit British micro, and now for Evercade!

games.title: International Karate (C64)
games.description: Strive for the black belt in the most popular 8-bit home computer version of System 3's martial arts classic, now on Evercade!

games.title: International Karate (ST)
games.description: Enjoy a brand new visual style in this 16-bit conversion of System 3's classic one-on-one fighting game, now for Evercade!

games.title: IK+ (ZX)
games.description: What's better than one-on-one fighting? Adding a third combatant to the mix! Embrace the chaos in this version of IK+, as originally released on a popular British micro, now for Evercade.

games.title: IK+ (C64)
games.description: Take on free-for-all three-man brawls in the most popular 8-bit version of System 3's martial arts legend, now available on Evercade!

games.title: IK+ (ST)
games.description: The three-way karate competition goes 16-bit in this classic version of System 3's fighting game hit, now for Evercade!

cartridges.title: BANJO-KAZOOIE Double Pack
cartridges.description: Two grand adventures await with the most famous bear and bird of the 64-bit era, now in new enhanced format for Evercade! Conquer the secrets of Gruntilda’s Lair in Banjo-Kazooie, then challenge the witch and her sisters to a rematch in Banjo-Tooie.

games.title: Banjo-Kazooie
games.description: Action and puzzles and bears, oh my! Banjo the bear and his fine-feathered friend, Kazooie, team up against Gruntilda the Witch in this brand-new enhanced Evercade port of the classic 3D platformer.

games.title: Banjo-Tooie
games.description: The bear and bird are back… but so is Gruntilda! Set off on another epic quest in this brand-new enhanced Evercade port of Rare's hit 3D platformer.

cartridges.title: The DOOM Collection
cartridges.description: Fight back against the hordes of hell in DOOM, DOOM II, six official mission packs and a special collection of Deathmatch levels!

games.title: DOOM
games.description: The demons came, and the space marines died. Except one. You are the last defence against these Hell-spawned hordes in the original first-person shooter classic, now on Evercade!

games.title: DOOM II
games.description: The entire forces of the netherworld have overrun Earth. To save her, you must descend into the stygian depths of Hell itself! Battle mightier, nastier, deadlier demons in this legendary sequel, now for Evercade.

games.title: Master Levels for DOOM II
games.description: Think you've mastered DOOM and DOOM II on Evercade? Challenge this official expansion for DOOM II, featuring levels originally created by top authors in the DOOM community and curated by id Software.

games.title: TNT: Evilution
games.description: A new invasion has come from space in this official mission pack, originally released as one half of Final DOOM. Blast through the hordes of Hell in 32 more levels of action for Evercade.

games.title: The Plutonia Experiment
games.description: One portal to Hell remains open, and it's up to you to close it in this concluding chapter of Final DOOM. 32 more levels of frantic first-person shooter action await in this mission pack for Evercade.

games.title: No Rest for the Living
games.description: Unfolding after the events of DOOM II, this 9-level mission pack presents some of the most challenging first-person shooter action on Evercade! Are you up to the task?

games.title: SIGIL
games.description: First released for DOOM's 25th anniversary, this new episode was developed by the original game's lead designer, John Romero. Battle through Baphomet's forces in nine more levels of action on Evercade.

games.title: SIGIL II
games.description: Released in celebration of DOOM's 30th anniversary, this follow-up to SIGIL features nine more levels created by the original game's lead designer, John Romero. Take on the ultimate Hellish challenge on Evercade!

games.title: DOOM: Deathmatch Pack
games.description: Need a break from battling the demonic hordes? Fight your friends on supported Evercade devices with this special collection of Deathmatch-specific levels!

cartridges.title: Visco Arcade 2
cartridges.description: Press Start on another great collection of arcade games from Visco! Includes two entries in the high-speed Drift Out series, the colourful fighting action of Breaker’s, the slick sports action of Battle Flip Shot and Bang Bead, cartoon mayhem in Captain Tomaday and Bang Bang Busters, and the hack-and-slash platforming of Ganryu.

games.title: Drift Out '94: The Hard Order
games.description: Put your foot to the floor in Drift Out '94, a high-speed racing classic from Visco, now available on Evercade!

games.title: Neo Drift Out: New Technology
games.description: The ultimate world rally challenge awaits in Neo Drift Out from Visco, an arcade classic you can now enjoy on Evercade!

games.title: Breaker's
games.description: Choose your warrior and battle for martial arts supremacy in the colourful fighting game, Breaker's, now on Evercade!

games.title: Battle Flip Shot
games.description: Battle Flip Shot for Evercade brings the classic computer ping-pong format bang up to date with colourful characters and special attacks!

games.title: Bang Bead
games.description: Bang Bead, the follow-up to Battle Flip Shot, brings even more action to the court with this speedy, technical twist on one of the oldest game formats. Enjoy it on Evercade!

games.title: Captain Tomaday
games.description: Take to the skies and spread your tomatoey goodness in Captain Tomaday, a classic Visco "cute 'em up" for Evercade!

games.title: Ganryu
games.description: Visco's Ganryu brings relentless hack-and-slash action based on Japanese legends to Evercade!

games.title: Bang Bang Busters
games.description: Help Lazy and Refia battle the evil forces of Emperor Honey in this colourful elimination platformer, now on Evercade!

cartridges.title: Visco Arcade 1
cartridges.description: Prepare for all-out arcade action with this collection of 8 hits from Visco. Includes the first entry in the renowned Drift Out series, the popular shoot ’em up Andro Dunos and more!

games.title: Andro Dunos
games.description: Fight back against an unknown lifeform's invasion in this spectacular shoot 'em up, now available for Evercade!

games.title: Ashura Blaster
games.description: Take command of the cutting-edge jet helicopters, Ashura 1 and 2, to thwart a rebel army's invasion in this scrolling shoot 'em up, now on Evercade!

games.title: Asuka & Asuka
games.description: Blast off and battle Galaxy Highter's forces through time and space in this exciting scrolling shoot 'em up for Evercade!

games.title: Drift Out
games.description: Take the wheel of one of seven different rally cars and put your foot to the floor in this high-speed top-down racer for Evercade!

games.title: Earth Joker: U.N. Defense Force
games.description: Earth has been invaded by the evil Slytow forces. Fight to reclaim our home planet in this near-future shoot 'em up, now on Evercade!

games.title: Galmedes
games.description: Take command of the powerful LEPTON weapons system and fight back against the dreaded Gildy's forces in this sci-fi shooter, now for Evercade!

games.title: Goal! Goal! Goal!
games.description: Pick your team from the 28 international squads available, and lead them to victory on the world stage in this speedy soccer game for Evercade!

games.title: Maze of Flott
games.description: Jump in your car and go in search of treasure! Explore open maps and even drive inside buildings in this maze action game, now on Evercade.

cartridges.title: NEOGEO Arcade 4
cartridges.description: NEOGEO returns to Evercade with an all-star lineup of 8 classics. Includes METAL SLUG 4, THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002, BLAZING STAR and more!

games.title: 3 COUNT BOUT
games.description: Battle in the ring, on the streets and in electric death matches in the NEOGEO's classic wrestling game, 3 COUNT BOUT. Compete against the computer or a friend, or team up with a pal for cooperative tag-team action!

games.title: BASEBALL STARS 2
games.description: Batter up! BASEBALL STARS 2, one of the NEOGEO's best sports games, comes to Evercade. Compete against a friend in the two-player versus mode, or take on the 15-game Pennant Race against the computer opponents!

games.title: BLAZING STAR
games.description: DANGEROUS! PAY ATTENTION TO BACKWARD! Take on the challenge of one of the best shoot 'em ups on NEOGEO with BLAZING STAR, now available for Evercade.

games.title: FATAL FURY SPECIAL
games.description: Terry Bogard and friends are back for another rumble in FATAL FURY SPECIAL, a classic NEOGEO fighting game, now on Evercade.

games.title: KING OF THE MONSTERS
games.description: Take control of a giant monster and battle to become KING OF THE MONSTERS in this classic NEOGEO title for Evercade. Battle one-on-one or team up with a friend to take down the computer-controlled kaiju!

games.title: METAL SLUG 4
games.description: METAL SLUG returns to Evercade with this NEOGEO classic. Battle as the veteran soldiers, Marco and Fio, or take command of the newcomers, Trevor and Nadia. Can you bring down the terrorists known as Amadeus?

games.title: ROBO ARMY
games.description: Neo Detroit has been overrun by an organisation known as Hell Jeed! Fight back at the head of the ROBO ARMY in this all-action NEOGEO beat 'em up, now on Evercade.

games.title: THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002
games.description: Form a team of three from an all-star cast and fight to become the champion! THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002 is a classic NEOGEO fighting game, now for Evercade!

cartridges.title: Activision Collection 3
cartridges.description: Activision is back on Evercade with another collection of ’80s classics. Includes Barnstorming, Chopper Command, Kaboom! and more!

games.title: Barnstorming
games.description: Embark on a daredevil flight through the wild blue yonder in this Activision air-racing classic, now on Evercade!

games.title: Bridge
games.description: Brush up on your skills at one of the world's most popular card games with Activision's Bridge for Evercade!

games.title: Chopper Command
games.description: Take the controls of a powerful helicopter gunship and defend your convoy from attack! This Activision favourite plays great on Evercade.

games.title: Dolphin
games.description: An endangered dolphin is calling you! Learn the dolphin's sonic language, guide her through schools of seahorses and gain magic powers from a seagull in this Activision hit for Evercade.

games.title: Dragonfire
games.description: Dragons have driven the Royal Court from the castle! The brave Prince steps up to save the day and the King's treasures from a dragon in this 8-bit favourite, now on Evercade.

games.title: Ice Hockey
games.description: Hit the ice and enter the slam-bang world of ice hockey in this 8-bit Activision sporting classic, now for Evercade!

games.title: Kabobber
games.description: Princess Buvsky is in pursuit of the magical Rainbow Energy, and it's up to you and your army of Buvskies to stop her! The chase is on in this Activision favourite for Evercade.

games.title: Kaboom!
games.description: You're about to face the world's most unpredictable and relentless Mad Bomber! Catch the bombs in this frantic 8-bit Activision classic, now for Evercade.

games.title: Keystone Kapers
games.description: Harry Hooligan is up to his old shenanigans! A game of cops and robbers awaits in this Activision hit for Evercade.

games.title: Laser Blast
games.description: Pilot a flying saucer and face off against dauntless enemy forces in this challenging shoot 'em up from Activision, now for Evercade!

games.title: Pressure Cooker
games.description: It's burger time once again in this Activision hit for Evercade! Take command of Short-Order Sam during the lunchtime rush and build as many burgers as you can!

games.title: The Activision Decathlon
games.description: Compete in the most celebrated of all athletic events in this Activision classic for Evercade! The ten events of the decathlon await; are you up to the challenge?

games.title: Thwocker
games.description: For Thwocker, music is his life, literally! Help him finish his symphony in this colourful Activision platformer, now for Evercade.

cartridges.title: Mega Cat Studios Collection 3
cartridges.description: Explore another collection of new games originally designed for classic gaming hardware, put together by the best and brightest of today’s independent developers!

games.title: Flap Happy
games.description: Flap your wings off in this 8-bit avian platformer for Evercade! Defy gravity, avoid menacing sharks and conquer hazardous landscapes as you flap your way through each level.

games.title: Gravibots
games.description: Get ready to totally flip out in this puzzle platformer for Evercade! Use your power over gravity to change your own polarity, cling to the ceilings and move blocks that will flip your foes on their head.

games.title: GunTneR
games.description: Take off for the 13th Dimension and save a sickly pet dingle! Battle enemies with your Quark Cannon and the experimental, unstable Chaos Cannon in this 8-bit shoot 'em up for Evercade.

games.title: Kudzu
games.description: The wizened gardening master, Zoen, has gone missing in a labyrinth made from the invasive kudzu plant. It's up to you to find him in this story-driven action-adventure for Evercade!

games.title: Machine Cave
games.description: Explore an interstellar maze in this physics-based piloting game for Evercade. Get ready to manoeuvre and drift as you pilot your spaceship with the forces of momentum, buoyancy and gravity!

games.title: The Meating
games.description: Konstantinos the minotaur found himself slaughtered after a blind date gone wrong. Become a ghost minotaur and take revenge on the one who butchered you in this puzzle platformer for Evercade!

games.title: Plyuk
games.description: Take control of Plyuk, a little creature that can clone himself, and escape from a nefarious laboratory in this 8-bit puzzler for Evercade!

games.title: Rocket Panda
games.description: In this fun jetpack adventure for Evercade, assume the role of Rocket Panda as you guide him through a terrifyingly tasty world of dangerous mazes. Can you defeat the evil Biscuit Head?

games.title: Super Fanger
games.description: Welcome to a thrilling game of tag like no other! Chase down your friends or evade their pursuit to avoid capture in this 16-bit thriller for Evercade.

games.title: Gumball in Trick-or-Treat Land
games.description: Gumball has fallen into Trick-or-Treat Land, and something is very wrong! Help him find his way home and battle the Chaos Sweets in this 8-bit role-playing adventure for Evercade.

cartridges.title: Activision Collection 2
cartridges.description: Activision returns to Evercade with another collection of ’80s classics. Includes H.E.R.O., Pitfall II: Lost Caverns, Stampede and more!

games.title: Boxing
games.description: Seconds out! Prove you're king of the ring on Evercade with Boxing, Activision's early take on the one-on-one fighting genre. Battle the computer boxer or challenge a friend on Evercade VS and Alpha!

games.title: Checkers
games.description: Enjoy a friendly board game on Evercade with Activision's Checkers! Take on a computer opponent with three difficulty levels, or compete against a friend!

games.title: Cosmic Commuter
games.description: It is the year 2075 AD, and you're in charge of getting the commuters to work on time in this Activision classic for Evercade. Can you handle the Astrobus?

games.title: Dragster
games.description: Timing and precision is the name of the game in this early Activision hit for Evercade. Pop the clutch, shift through the gears and burn up that quarter mile!

games.title: H.E.R.O.
games.description: Launch a Helicopter Emergency Rescue Operation with this popular and influential Activision legend, now on Evercade. Explore perilous caverns, blast vile vermin and rescue the miners!

games.title: Moonsweeper
games.description: Pilot the U.S.S. Moonsweeper and rescue the miners stranded on hostile moons in this Activision classic, now for Evercade! Can you survive the perils of Star Quadrant Jupiter²?

games.title: Oink!
games.description: Bigelow B. Wolf is going to huff, puff and blow your house down in this Activision favourite, now on Evercade! Help the Three Little Pigs save their homes (and their bacon) from a terrible fate.

games.title: Pitfall II: Lost Caverns
games.description: Pitfall Harry is back in a whole new Activision adventure, now on Evercade. Explore the Lost Caverns deep beneath Peru, discover treasure and rescue Harry's companions!

games.title: Plaque Attack
games.description: Dental hygiene has never been so much fun! Blast the junk food and protect your teeth in this popular Activision hit, now on Evercade.

games.title: River Raid II
games.description: Fly back into the danger zone with this classic Activision sequel for Evercade. Launch from your carrier, take aim for the river valley and destroy the enemy bridges!

games.title: Robot Tank
games.description: The enemy Robot Tanks are advancing! Fight through the day, night and varied weather conditions in this Activision hit for Evercade.

games.title: Seaquest
games.description: Deep beneath the ocean, your divers have found buried treasure! It's up to you to rescue them in this subaquatic shooter from Activision, now on Evercade.

games.title: Skiing
games.description: With Evercade, you can ski all year long! Skiing by Activision challenges you with a wide variety of slalom and downhill runs, designed for everyone from amateur to pro.

games.title: Spider Fighter
games.description: Blast the bugs and protect your orchard from invasion in this Activision classic for Evercade! Take down the Master Nest and its Spy Pods, but watch out for Green Widows and Stingers!

games.title: Stampede
games.description: Yeehaw! Grab your lasso and ride 'em, cowboy, 'cuz them dogies ain't gonna herd themselves! Take to the trails and catch the cattle in this Activision hit, now on Evercade.

cartridges.title: TAITO Arcade 3
cartridges.description: Return to the arcade with another collection of all-time classics from TAITO, including the popular PUZZLE BOBBLE, the abstract QIX, the cooperative action-adventure of CADASH and more!

games.title: CADASH
games.description: Challenge an epic quest on Evercade! Save Princess Sarasa from the dreaded Baarogue in CADASH, a cooperative action-adventure with role-playing elements from TAITO.

games.title: CAMELTRY
games.description: Spin the maze to reach the goal in CAMELTRY, a challenging maze action game for Evercade from TAITO. The faster you reach the goal, the more you'll score, but watch out for obstacles!

games.title: CRAZY BALLOON
games.description: Take on a game of strategy and skill on Evercade! The object of this TAITO classic is to guide a delicate swaying balloon through a maze of pinwheel obstacles. You'll need a steady hand to succeed.

games.title: FOOTBALL CHAMP
games.description: FOOTBALL CHAMP for Evercade contains all the sights, sounds and action of real football. The special animation and zoom-in features of this TAITO classic will have you cheering for more.

games.title: LUNAR RESCUE
games.description: Save the astronauts in LUNAR RESCUE, a TAITO classic for Evercade! Descend to the lunar surface, save stranded space pilots and rendezvous with your mothership. Watch out for obstacles and UFOs!

games.title: PUZZLE BOBBLE
games.description: PUZZLE BOBBLE is a competitive puzzle game by TAITO. The rules are easy! Shoot a ball towards those of the same colour, and pop groups of three or more in this puzzler classic for Evercade.

games.title: QIX
games.description: Box in QIX, the spinning helix, in this abstract arcade classic from TAITO, now on Evercade. Every game is a little bit different!

games.title: THE FAIRYLAND STORY
games.description: Defeat the monsters deep inside the castle in this TAITO classic, now for Evercade. Control the witch Ptolemy and use her magic to transform monsters into delicious but deadly cakes!

games.title: ZOO KEEPER
games.description: It's a zoo in there, and the animals are eating their way out in this TAITO classic for Evercade! Box in the restless animals and save Zeke the zoo keeper's beloved Zelda from danger in this all-action arcade hit.

cartridges.title: The Turrican Collection
cartridges.description: Welcome to Turrican! Blast through one of the best names in 16-bit run and gun action with The Turrican Collection cartridge for Evercade. Includes the classic home computer games where it all began, the visually spectacular console entries in the series, plus special Director’s Cut and Score Attack versions of Mega Turrican and Super Turrican!

games.title: Turrican
games.description: Track down and destroy the dreaded Morgul in the 16-bit home computer version of Turrican, the beginning of an action-packed saga, now on Evercade!

games.title: Turrican II: The Final Fight
games.description: Free the planet of Landorin from the dreaded Machine in the 16-bit home computer version of Turrican II: The Final Fight, now for Evercade!

games.title: Turrican 3
games.description: The Machine is back on Evercade in the 16-bit home computer version of Turrican 3! Lead the United Planets Freedom Forces and save the day in this all-action classic.

games.title: Mega Turrican
games.description: Turrican comes to 16-bit home consoles with Mega Turrican. In this run-and-gun classic for Evercade, you'll battle the dreaded forces of the evil Machine.

games.title: Mega Turrican Director's Cut
games.description: Take on the challenge of this bonus remixed version of Mega Turrican on Evercade! This special Director's Cut version features new visuals and content cut from the original console release.

games.title: Mega Turrican Score Attack
games.description: Do you rate your skills at Mega Turrican? Take on the ultimate challenge on Evercade with this special Score Attack remix. Battle through a specially designed level to attain the best score you can.

games.title: Super Turrican
games.description: Save the planet Katakis from the dreaded Machine once more in the 16-bit home console classic Super Turrican, now on Evercade!

games.title: Super Turrican Director's Cut
games.description: Enjoy new visuals and remixed, expanded levels in this bonus Director's Cut version of Super Turrican, now for Evercade!

games.title: Super Turrican Score Attack
games.description: The battle is on for a high score in this specially remixed version of Super Turrican for Evercade! Fight through a specially designed level and prove your mastery.

games.title: Super Turrican 2
games.description: Armageddon has arrived in the visually spectacular Super Turrican 2 for Evercade, an all-action 16-bit classic. Battle on foot and in vehicles in this climactic entry of the Turrican saga.

cartridges.title: The Llamasoft Collection
cartridges.description: British game maker Jeff Minter is one of the original independent developers. In this collection, we celebrate 27 of his all-time best home computer classics, including Attack of the Mutant Camels, Gridrunner and more!

games.title: Abductor
games.description: Take command of a laser base and fend off the alien abductors in this all-action 8-bit Llamasoft shoot 'em up, now on Evercade.

games.title: Andes Attack
games.description: Take flight over the mountains of Peru and save the llamas in this Llamasoft classic, now for Evercade.

games.title: Deflex V
games.description: Simple but compelling puzzle and reflex action awaits in one of Jeff Minter's earliest games, now playable on Evercade.

games.title: Gridrunner (version A)
games.description: Take to the Grid and blast the deadly Droid forces in this Evercade version of one of Llamasoft's most enduringly popular games.

games.title: Hell Gate (version A)
games.description: Take command of the Hell Gate near Pluto, and prevent an alien invasion from reaching Earth in this frantic, mind-bending Llamasoft shoot 'em up for Evercade.

games.title: Laser Zone (version A)
games.description: Two guns are better than one in this Jeff Minter classic, now available on Evercade. Can you handle the Laser Zone?

games.title: Matrix: Gridrunner 2 (version A)
games.description: Return to the Grid and fend off a renewed assault from the Droids in the Evercade version of this Llamasoft hit.

games.title: Metagalactic Llamas Battle at the Edge of Time (version A)
games.description: Spit lasers at the incoming cyborg arachnids in this spectacularly named Llamasoft classic, now on Evercade.

games.title: Ratman!
games.description: You are the Ratman, and you have a big hammer. Fend off the never-ending hordes of rats in this Llamasoft rarity, now for Evercade.

games.title: Ancipital
games.description: 100 rooms of hallucinogenic action await in this deep, challenging Llamasoft arcade adventure for Evercade.

games.title: Attack of the Mutant Camels
games.description: One of Llamasoft's most famous games comes to Evercade. Pilot your ship in combat against the dreaded laser-spitting, neutronium-shielded mutant camels!

games.title: Batalyx
games.description: Launch an assault on Zzyax Prime in this innovative six-part arcade game. One of Llamasoft's most intriguing, creative games is now on Evercade.

games.title: Gridrunner (version B)
games.description: Challenge the Grid once again in this higher resolution version of the classic Llamasoft shoot 'em up Gridrunner, now on Evercade.

games.title: Hell Gate (version B)
games.description: Take control of the Hell Gate once more in a later port of this all-action Llamasoft classic, now for Evercade.

games.title: Hover Bovver
games.description: Gordon Bennet wants to mow his lawn, but his mower's broken! Take up the surprisingly fiendish challenge of borrowing his neighbour's mower in this Llamasoft classic for Evercade.

games.title: Laser Zone (version B)
games.description: Tackle the unique challenges of this later version of Laser Zone, a classic Llamasoft blastathon, now on Evercade!

games.title: Matrix: Gridrunner 2 (version B)
games.description: Brave the Grid once again in this higher resolution version of the frantic Llamasoft shoot 'em up Matrix, now for Evercade.

games.title: Metagalactic Llamas Battle at the Edge of Time (version B)
games.description: The Meta-Llamas are back in this later version of Jeff Minter's chaotic arachnid-blasting shoot 'em up, now on Evercade.

games.title: Revenge of the Mutant Camels (version A)
games.description: Once, they were the enemy. Now, it's time for them to strike back at their Zzyaxian former masters in this Llamasoft classic for Evercade!

games.title: Revenge of the Mutant Camels II
games.description: The camels are back once again in this frantic, gleefully hallucinogenic shoot 'em up, now available for Evercade.

games.title: Sheep in Space
games.description: Defend the human supply modules from a Zzyaxian invasion in this innovative double-sided shoot 'em up from Llamasoft. Be careful not to eat until you explode!

games.title: Voidrunner
games.description: It's time to take the fight to the Droids in the finale of the Gridrunner saga, now on Evercade. Can you handle four ships at once?

games.title: City Bomb
games.description: Your plane is rapidly losing altitude, and there's nowhere to land! Only one thing for it: bomb the buildings beneath you to the ground in this 8-bit Llamasoft classic for Evercade!

games.title: Superdeflex
games.description: Sid the silly space alien is fed up with being shot, so he's got a whole new challenge for you. Deflect him into the prizes but watch out for the hazards in this Llamasoft puzzler for Evercade.

games.title: Llamatron: 2112
games.description: Jeff Minter's famous homage to classic '80s arcade games comes to Evercade. Blast the baddies and save the furry, fluffy and woolly creatures from a terrible fate!

games.title: Revenge of the Mutant Camels (version B)
games.description: The 16-bit port of Revenge of the Mutant Camels is more than just a fancy coat of paint. Explore new challenges and expanded game mechanics in this Llamasoft classic, now on Evercade!

games.title: Super Gridrunner
games.description: The Earth is in danger… again! Take on the dreaded Slimelords of Xtharrgg in this 16-bit, 512-colour reimagining of Llamasoft's famous shoot 'em up, now for Evercade.

cartridges.title: Rare Collection 1
cartridges.description: Rare is one of the best-known names in British game development, and in this collection for Evercade you’ll explore 12 all-time favourites. Includes the home computer classics Jetpac, Atic Atac, Knight Lore and more. Plus, race on land and sea with the 8-bit console hits R.C. Pro-Am and Cobra Triangle, rescue a ruined birthday in Conker’s Pocket Tales, and kick the Dark Queen’s butt in the 8-bit console and arcade versions of Battletoads!

games.title: Jetpac
games.description: Rare's earliest game is one of its most famous! Build rockets, refuel them and get rich in this beloved home computer game, now available for Evercade.

games.title: Lunar Jetman
games.description: The aliens are mustering for an attack on Earth in Rare's follow-up to Jetpac. Drive your lunar rover, collect useful tools and thwart the attack in this home computer classic for Evercade.

games.title: Atic Atac
games.description: Trapped in the Haunted Castle, your only way out is to find all three parts of a special key! Frantic action and adventure awaits in this home computer hit by Rare, now on Evercade.

games.title: Sabre Wulf
games.description: Rare's Sabreman series begins with a jungle adventure. Explore a huge map, battle wildlife and seek a magic amulet in this home computer classic for Evercade.

games.title: Underwurlde
games.description: The only way is down, then back up again in the second Sabreman adventure from Rare! Delve into the depths of the Underwurlde in search of magic weapons in this home computer favourite, now for Evercade.

games.title: Knight Lore
games.description: Rare's Sabreman series continues with the influential isometric action-adventure Knight Lore. Can you save Sabreman from a deadly curse in this home computer classic for Evercade?

games.title: Gunfright
games.description: The West was won from a quasi-3D perspective in this all-action, rootin' tootin' isometric adventure from Rare. Track down bandits and show 'em the justice of the Old West in this home computer hit for Evercade.

games.title: R.C. Pro-Am
games.description: Grab your remote control and get ready for some intense racing action! Rare's classic 8-bit isometric racer-with-weapons comes to Evercade.

games.title: Cobra Triangle
games.description: You can handle a remote control car, but how about a state-of-the-art powerboat? Find out in Cobra Triangle, Rare's 8-bit console hit, now on Evercade.

games.title: Battletoads
games.description: The Dark Queen has kidnapped Princess Angelica and your buddy Pimple! Take the fight to her (and brave the notorious Turbo Tunnel) in this 8-bit legend from Rare, now for Evercade.

games.title: Battletoads Arcade
games.description: Can't get enough of the Toads? Rare's arcade take on the franchise is a whole new game that cranks up the action and violence as you once again battle the Dark Queen and her minions on Evercade.

games.title: Conker's Pocket Tales
games.description: Before Conker got a potty mouth, he had his birthday ruined by the Evil Acorn! Explore vast worlds and save the day in this 8-bit handheld hit, now for Evercade.

cartridges.title: Activision Collection 1
cartridges.description: As the first third-party video game developer, Activision quickly became synonymous with high-quality games that pushed the boundaries of what early games consoles were capable of. Enjoy 15 of the company’s greatest hits in this Evercade collection.

games.title: Beamrider
games.description: You are the Beamrider! Demolish the alien forces and liberate the Earth from the 99-sector Restrictor Shield in this awesome Activision shoot 'em up, now on Evercade.

games.title: Crackpots
games.description: There's a bug in the system in this Activision hit, now on Evercade. As the brave Potsy, take potshots at the invading insects before they eat you out of house and home!

games.title: Demon Attack
games.description: One of the most beloved fixed shooters from the early days of gaming comes to Evercade! Can you survive a full 84 waves in this Activision classic?

games.title: Enduro
games.description: Fasten your seatbelt for the ride of your life in this legendary Activision racer for Evercade. Drive as fast as you can, as long as you can, but beware the rapidly changing weather and road conditions!

games.title: Fishing Derby
games.description: You'll be hooked on this competitive classic from Activision, now for Evercade. Cast your line and reel in the biggest catch you can against the clock, but watch out for the shark!

games.title: Freeway
games.description: Why did the chicken cross the road? Because it made for a fun game! See how many times you can cross a busy freeway against the clock, either solo or against a friend in this Activision gem for Evercade.

games.title: Grand Prix
games.description: Put the pedal to the metal in this Activision smash hit, now for Evercade. Beat the clock and your rival drivers across four challenging courses.

games.title: MegaMania
games.description: It's a space nightmare in this Activision masterpiece, now on Evercade! Blast burgers, cookies, bugs and more, and don't give in to the pressure!

games.title: Pitfall!
games.description: Activision's genre-defining platformer comes to Evercade. As the brave Pitfall Harry, you have 32 treasures to find across 255 deadly screens! Are you up to the challenge?

games.title: Private Eye
games.description: Henri Le Fiend is up to no good, and it's up to you to stop him in this Activision action adventure. Track down evidence and stolen items, but watch out for Le Fiend's devious henchmen!

games.title: River Raid
games.description: Brave the River of No Return in this Activision shoot 'em up legend for Evercade. Blast enemy tankers, helicopters, fuel depots, jets and bridges, and survive as long as you can!

games.title: Sky Jinks
games.description: Take to the skies and prove your piloting skills in this Activision air race, now for Evercade! Weave between the pylons to complete the course, but watch out for errant balloonists and tall trees!

games.title: Space Shuttle: A Journey Into Space
games.description: Did you ever want to be an astronaut as a kid? It's not an easy job, as you'll discover in Activision's ambitious and in-depth Shuttle simulation for Evercade!

games.title: StarMaster
games.description: The starbases are in danger! Fire up the warp engines and blast the enemy forces into oblivion in this classic Activision space sim for Evercade.

games.title: Tennis
games.description: Anyone for tennis? Take on the Activision computer pro or a friend in this simple but addictive sports sim for Evercade!

cartridges.title: NEOGEO Arcade 3
cartridges.description: NEOGEO Arcade 3 brings six more NEOGEO legends to Evercade for the first time. Prove your martial prowess in the fighting game classics THE KING OF FIGHTERS ’97 and SAMURAI SHODOWN II, fend off alien mischief in METAL SLUG 3, master the innovative competitive shoot ’em up action of TWINKLE STAR SPRITES, and more!

games.title: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97
games.description: THE KING OF FIGHTERS tournament is back on Evercade! Battle in teams of three to prove who really is the best of the best in this NEOGEO fighting game classic.

games.title: METAL SLUG 3
games.description: Marco, Tarma, Eri and Fio are back once again with another explosive NEOGEO mission on Evercade. Run and gun through visually spectacular levels with multiple routes, and fend off an alien invasion!

games.title: TWINKLE STAR SPRITES
games.description: NEOGEO classic TWINKLE STAR SPRITES, now for Evercade, brings a competitive twist to the shoot 'em up genre, as the baddies you blast become your attacks on your opponent!

games.title: SAMURAI SHODOWN II
games.description: Draw your sword and prepare to battle in this skilful NEOGEO fighting game, now for Evercade. Master the sword snag and feint dash techniques, and make good use of your Rage Gauge for victory!

games.title: GHOST PILOTS
games.description: It's a war on two fronts, and the GHOST PILOTS are faced with seemingly insurmountable odds in this NEOGEO shoot 'em up classic, now for Evercade.

games.title: SUPER SIDEKICKS
games.description: Compete for the SNK Cup in this all-action NEOGEO soccer game, now for Evercade! Play solo against the CPU teams, or challenge a friend on Evercade VS and Alpha!

cartridges.title: NEOGEO Arcade 2
cartridges.description: Enjoy six more classics from the golden age of pixel art! Includes GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES, ART OF FIGHTING 2, METAL SLUG 2, CROSSED SWORDS, NINJA COMMANDO and SENGOKU 2.

games.title: GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES
games.description: Legends don't die. They get better. Battle as Rock Howard, Terry Bogard and more in this deep NEOGEO fighting game, now on Evercade!

games.title: ART OF FIGHTING 2
games.description: Marvel at some of the biggest, most detailed sprites in the entire 2D fighting genre with ART OF FIGHTING 2, a NEOGEO classic, now for Evercade!

games.title: METAL SLUG 2
games.description: General Morden strikes again in this NEOGEO run-and-gun classic for Evercade! Battle as Marco Rossi, Tarma Roving or newcomers Eri Kasamoto and Fio Germi.

games.title: CROSSED SWORDS
games.description: Battle through a fantasy world of swords and magic in this NEOGEO classic, now for Evercade! Can you defeat the dreaded Nausizz and save Belcana?

games.title: NINJA COMMANDO
games.description: Travel through time and thwart the plans of the evil Spider in this NEOGEO top-down run-and-gun classic, now for Evercade!

games.title: SENGOKU 2
games.description: Hack and slash your way through several different time periods on your quest to take down the Dark Shogun! This all-action NEOGEO classic is now on Evercade.

cartridges.title: Taito Arcade 2
cartridges.description: Save the hostages in the classic shooter OPERATION WOLF. Rescue the Kiwis in THE NEWZEALAND STORY. Hack and slash through a fantasy world in RASTAN. And many more!

games.title: OPERATION WOLF
games.description: As an elite special forces operative, you've been tasked with infiltrating enemy territory and saving the hostages. Bring the heavy firepower in this classic TAITO arcade shooter for Evercade!

games.title: THE NEWZEALAND STORY
games.description: Tiki the kiwi's pals have been kidnapped by a leopard seal! Launch a rescue mission in this super-cute platform action game from TAITO, now on Evercade.

games.title: RASTAN
games.description: The saga of a great hero begins! Hack and slash your way through countless enemies in your quest for glory in this TAITO arcade classic, now for Evercade.

games.title: ELEVATOR ACTION
games.description: Agent Otto needs your help in this espionage thriller from TAITO! Track down the secret plans, battle enemy agents, and make your daring escape on Evercade.

games.title: LIQUID KIDS
games.description: Take control of the brave Hipopo and save Woody-Lake from the Fire Devil! Enjoy this TAITO arcade classic on Evercade.

games.title: KIKI KAIKAI
games.description: The spirits are coming! Fend off an otherworldly invasion with just your trusty talismans and purification rod in this TAITO arcade legend, now for Evercade.

games.title: VOLFIED
games.description: Aliens have invaded your home planet! Use your laser cutter to recapture your territory in this area-control classic from TAITO, now on Evercade.

games.title: ALPINE SKI
games.description: Hit the slopes in this winter sports classic from TAITO! Challenge downhill, slalom and ski-jump races, all from the comfort of your Evercade.

games.title: THE ELECTRIC YO-YO
games.description: Walk the Dog, Around the World… ENERGISE! Use your trusty yo-yo to battle the TRIONS and BIONS for control of the BLOX in this TAITO arcade hit, now for Evercade.

cartridges.title: Taito Arcade 1
cartridges.description: 9 all-time TAITO classics arrive on Evercade! Includes the legendary SPACE INVADERS and the beloved BUBBLE BOBBLE, plus DON DOKO DON, GROWL, THE LEGEND OF KAGE and more!

games.title: BUBBLE BOBBLE
games.description: Begin a fantastic story and journey to the Cave of Monsters on Evercade with BUBBLE BOBBLE, the genre-defining elimination platformer from TAITO!

games.title: SPACE INVADERS
games.description: SPACE INVADERS from TAITO is one of the most influential video games of all time. Enjoy it in its original arcade incarnation on Evercade!

games.title: THE LEGEND OF KAGE
games.description: Battle with your swords and throwing knives to save Princess Kiri in this all-action TAITO arcade classic, now on Evercade!

games.title: GROWL
games.description: Fight for the rights of endangered animals in GROWL by TAITO, a classic arcade beat 'em up, now available for Evercade.

games.title: DON DOKO DON
games.description: Take up your trusty mallet and save the royal family in DON DOKO DON, another classic TAITO elimination platformer for Evercade!

games.title: CHACK'N POP
games.description: Chack'n and Miss Chack'n want nothing more than a happy wedding, but the Monstas have other ideas! Save the day in this TAITO classic for Evercade.

games.title: PIRATE PETE
games.description: Swing across ropes, swim through the briny depths, negotiate an avalanche and outwit your enemies to save your loved one in this TAITO arcade classic for Evercade.

games.title: RAIMAIS
games.description: Brave the labyrinth and save your brother in this all-action maze chase arcade game from TAITO, now on Evercade!

games.title: COLONY 7
games.description: Battle the relentless Jarvian forces with your cannons, Mega-Buster and Eradicator weapons in this frantic TAITO arcade shoot 'em up, now for Evercade!

cartridges.title: NEOGEO Arcade 1
cartridges.description: Explore one of the greatest arcade systems of all time with this collection of NEOGEO hits for Evercade. Includes METAL SLUG, THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2000, SHOCK TROOPERS, MAGICIAN LORD, SENGOKU and IRONCLAD.

games.title: METAL SLUG
games.description: One of the NEOGEO's most famous franchises comes to Evercade! Battle against the rebel forces and take command of the powerful Metal Slug tank in this spectacular run-and-gun hit.

games.title: THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2000
games.description: Mai Shiranui, Terry Bogard, Athena Asamiya and a host of other beloved characters await in this legendary NEOGEO fighting game, now on Evercade!

games.title: SHOCK TROOPERS
games.description: Visually stunning top-down run-and-gun action awaits in this all-time NEOGEO classic, now for Evercade. Battle as a "lonely wolf" or take a team of specialists into action!

games.title: MAGICIAN LORD
games.description: Discover where it all began with the NEOGEO launch title, MAGICIAN LORD, now for Evercade. Transform into powerful creatures in this magical quest to save the world from an evil sorcerer!

games.title: SENGOKU
games.description: A 400-year-old prophecy has come true in this NEOGEO hit for Evercade. Battle through modern-day Washington D.C. and a strange parallel world to defeat a warlord and his army of spirits!

games.title: IRONCLAD
games.description: Spectacular steampunk shoot 'em up action awaits in IRONCLAD, a fascinating NEOGEO rarity, now available on Evercade.

cartridges.title: Roguecraft DX
cartridges.description: The modern Amiga hit, winner of the Retro World Award at the 2025 Debug Indie Game Awards, comes to Evercade in an all-new expanded, enhanced form!

games.title: Roguecraft DX
games.description: For time immemorial, legend has told of a dark, deadly dungeon containing unimaginable horrors and riches beyond belief. Dive into that dungeon and seek your fortune with this all-new deluxe version of Roguecraft for Evercade!

cartridges.title: Windjammers, Karnov & Friends
cartridges.description: Get ready for action in 5 all-time arcade classics for Evercade. Throw the Flying Power Disc in the highly competitive Windjammers, search for treasure with Karnov, run for your life in Atomic Runner Chelnov and take on the dreaded Lagnalok forces in Vapor Trail: Hyper Offence Formation and Rohga: Armor Force!

games.title: Windjammers
games.description: Welcome to the world of Flying Power Disc! This high-speed, frantic sports title is a big hit on the competitive circuit, and now you can enjoy it on Evercade!

games.title: Karnov
games.description: Jinborov "Karnov" Karnovski is an all-time gaming icon. Now you can relive his most famous adventure as he sets off on a quest for hidden treasure on Evercade!

games.title: Atomic Runner Chelnov
games.description: Having been blessed with strange powers following a nuclear accident, Chelnov must run for his life and defeat a mysterious organisation in this all-action arcade game for Evercade!

games.title: Vapor Trail: Hyper Offence Formation
games.description: Take to the skies and rock out to an excellent soundtrack in this explosive vertically scrolling shoot 'em up for Evercade. Can you defeat the dreaded Lagnalok forces?

games.title: Rohga: Armor Force
games.description: Build your own mech or choose from four pre-built models, then take it into action against the returning Lagnalok forces in this explosive arcade sequel for Evercade!

cartridges.title: Gremlin Collection 2
cartridges.description: Gremlin returns to Evercade with the explosive action of Loaded and Re-Loaded, the comedic mayhem of Hogs of War and the adventure racing of Buggy.

games.title: Loaded
games.description: Lead a prison break and take on the might of the megalomaniac F.U.B. in this all-action 32-bit classic, now available on Evercade!

games.title: Re-Loaded
games.description: The ex-convicts are back, and they brought friends! Blast your way through a series of explosive missions and take down the nefarious C.H.E.B. in this 32-bit sequel for Evercade.

games.title: Hogs of War
games.description: Cry 'havoc!' and let slip the Hogs of War! Take on a series of missions or battle up to three friends in this hilarious 32-bit action-strategy game, now on Evercade.

games.title: Buggy
games.description: Get ready for some chaotic 32-bit racing action in Buggy, now on Evercade. Compete against a field of opponents or explore the courses to find hidden secrets!

cartridges.title: Tomb Raider Collection 2
cartridges.description: The legend of Lara Croft continues on Evercade! Uncover an ancient Egyptian mystery and prevent the end of the world in Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation, and relive a series of Lara’s most noteworthy adventures from her past in Tomb Raider: Chronicles. Also includes a brand-new version of a special bonus level, previously only distributed for home computers.

games.title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
games.description: Lara Croft returns to Evercade in an all-action Egyptian adventure. The dread god Set's resurrection is at hand, and the fate of the world is at stake! Can Lara save the day? Also includes a special bonus level previously only distributed on PC!

games.title: Tomb Raider: Chronicles
games.description: In Tomb Raider: Chronicles for Evercade, three individuals have come together to commemorate the life and career of Lara Croft. As they tell their stories, relive those classic adventures for yourself!

cartridges.title: Atari Arcade 2
cartridges.description: Enjoy 10 classic early ’80s arcade games from Atari on Evercade, including the legendary Berzerk and its sequel Frenzy, plus cult favourites like Maze Invaders, Fire Truck and more!

games.title: Berzerk
games.description: It's Berzerk inside an electric maze, where robots shoot with electric rays! So look out, don't get trapped, or you might get zapped! Berzerk is here from Atari… and Evercade. Watch out for Evil Otto!

games.title: Frenzy
games.description: What if Berzerk, but… more? The all-action sequel from Atari comes to Evercade, once again casting you as the brave humanoid standing alone against Evil Otto and his robot hordes.

games.title: Tazz-Mania
games.description: Take arena shooting to the next level with Tazz-Mania from Atari on Evercade. Rapid-fire your way through hordes of enemies, but work quickly, as the walls are closing in on you!

games.title: Lost Tomb
games.description: Deep in the Amazon lies a great pyramid, and it's your job to loot it in this all-action adventure from Atari, now on Evercade.

games.title: Moon War
games.description: Descend to the lunar surface and defend your supply bases from attack in this scrolling shoot 'em up from Atari, now on Evercade!

games.title: Dark Planet
games.description: Brave the Dark Planet in this innovative "dual layer" arcade shoot 'em up from Atari, recreated faithfully on Evercade.

games.title: Rescue
games.description: There's choppy waters ahead in this helicopter rescue game from Atari, now on Evercade. Can you rescue the stranded paratroopers before the enemy gets to them?

games.title: Mine Field
games.description: 90 miles of desert stand between you and victory in this scrolling tank shooter from Atari, now available for Evercade. Stock up on missiles, then let the enemy have it!

games.title: Fire Truck
games.description: FIRE! Hit the streets in this classic Atari driving game from the early days of arcades, now on Evercade. Race as far as you can before fuel runs out, but take care not to skid out!

games.title: Maze Invaders
games.description: Gobble up the fruit in a series of ever-changing mazes in this cult favourite from Atari. Maze Invaders was never released in '80s arcades, but now you can enjoy it on Evercade!

cartridges.title: Broken Sword Collection
cartridges.description: Paris in the fall holds many memories for George Stobbart: of cafés, of music, of love, and of death. Now on Evercade, you can explore the first two adventures in this legendary series, presented in their original 32-bit console form.

games.title: Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars
games.description: Uncover the identity of a jester assassin, unlock the legends of the Knights Templar and unravel a plot as twisted as the catacombs you'll be prowling in this 32-bit point-and-click adventure for Evercade!

games.title: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror
games.description: Prepare for the end of the world in this 32-bit point-and-click adventure for Evercade! American tourist George Stobbart returns to save the world from the Mayan god of sacrifice in this thrilling sequel.

cartridges.title: Indie Heroes Collection 4
cartridges.description: The Indie Heroes return to Evercade with another lineup of new games made for (and in the style of) vintage gaming hardware. Includes the dig-and-bomb ’em up action of Murtop, the inimitable bouncy platforming of Flea!2, Batty Zabella’s saucy adventures and many more!

games.title: The Curse of Illmoore Bay
games.description: In this spooky platformer for Evercade, Cole, Scarlett and Issa must protect Illmoore Bay from the evil Umbra's devilish plans!

games.title: Block'Em Sock'Em
games.description: Toss blocks and match colours in this puzzler for Evercade! Clear enough blocks from a stage to advance, and take advantage of special blocks for those hard-to-reach areas.

games.title: Nyghtmare: The Ninth King
games.description: This atmospheric platformer for Evercade casts you in the role of the heroic Aryn or Blizz, and tasks you with unravelling the mystery behind the reappearance of the cursed kingdom of Mortemire.

games.title: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure
games.description: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a person in possession of an Evercade, must be in want of a good platformer. And this Regency England-inspired platformer is definitely a good 'un.

games.title: Collie Defense
games.description: Protect the sheep from the unwanted attention of predators in this tower defense title for Evercade. Take on bears, tigers, foxes and more!

games.title: Flea!2
games.description: Henry the Flea is back in this precision platformer for Evercade. Bounce your way through more than 90 stages to free the "here-tick" enemies of the devilish Flea-opatra!

games.title: Batty Zabella
games.description: Batty Zabella's beloved Husbano has disappeared, and it's up to you to help her find him in this saucy, spooky adventure for Evercade.

games.title: Murtop
games.description: Murti the bomb-pooping rabbit has a mission: eliminate all the nasty moles! Dig through the dirt and blast your enemies in this all-action arcade-style romp for Evercade.

games.title: Soko Banana
games.description: Help Skid the monkey save the Great Banana Festival from ruin in this Sokoban-inspired puzzler for Evercade. Plan your moves carefully as you slide the crates into position!

games.title: Starseed
games.description: Blast your way through enemy forces and destroy massive enemy dreadnoughts in this 8-bit shoot 'em up for Evercade. Can you survive the onslaught?

games.title: Block Droppin'
games.description: Classic "match three" gameplay comes to Evercade with this block-swapping puzzler. Connect lines of three or more blocks of the same colour to eliminate them, and set up chain reactions for big points!

cartridges.title: Toaplan Arcade 4
cartridges.description: Toaplan Arcade 4 for Evercade brings together 6 more all-action arcade hits from the beloved Japanese developer Toaplan. Blast off for explosive action in the shoot ’em ups Dogyuun and Grind Stormer, enjoy cartoony platform fun in Snow Bros. 2 and Pipi and Bibi’s, and hit the streets in the wrestling-themed beat ’em up Knuckle Bash.

games.title: Dogyuun
games.description: Classic vertically scrolling shoot 'em up Dogyuun is now on Evercade! Blast off and battle against your enigmatic mechanical foes with a range of powerful laser beam weaponry. Combine your firepower with a second player to unleash even more destruction!

games.title: Grind Stormer
games.description: Grind Stormer, another action-packed vertical scroller from Toaplan, comes to Evercade! Players have been mysteriously disappearing after piloting the NA-00 space fighter in the ultimate arcade machine, and it's up to you to uncover the truth.

games.title: Knuckle Bash
games.description: Enjoy Toaplan's wrestling-themed take on the beat 'em up, now on Evercade! Choose your character, then hit the streets to take down the Mad Bull Group and save the reputation of your favourite sport.

games.title: Snow Bros. 2
games.description: The follow-up to one of Toaplan's most popular games, Snow Bros., comes to Evercade! Choose one of four bizarre characters and clear screen after screen of enemies in this chaotic elimination platformer.

games.title: Pipi and Bibi's
games.description: A cult favourite from Toaplan's back catalogue arrives on Evercade. Take command of the bumbling spies Pipi and Bibi as they plant bombs in gangsters' hideouts… and perhaps meet some charming ladies along the way!

games.title: Sky Shark (console version)
games.description: The well-regarded 8-bit console port of Toaplan's classic Flying Shark comes to Evercade, featuring music by the legendary Tim Follin. Pilot your plane deep into enemy territory and fend off ferocious attacks from air, land and sea!

cartridges.title: Metal Dragon/Life on Mars
cartridges.description: Kai Magazine Software brings two action-packed 16-bit titles to Evercade. Battle to prevent World War III in Metal Dragon, and solve the mystery of a seemingly abandoned space colony in Life on Mars!

games.title: Metal Dragon
games.description: The President's daughter has been kidnapped, and Metal Dragon is the only one who can save her in this 16-bit run and gun action game. The powers that be want this to be a stealthy mission, but Metal Dragon has other ideas… and easy access to lots of guns.

games.title: Life on Mars
games.description: Take on the role of space technician Sam in this 16-bit exploration platformer. The scientific colony on Mars has lost contact with Earth, and it's up to you to discover what's wrong. Upgrade your environmental suit to overcome a variety of challenges, and find the truth before it's too late!

cartridges.title: Data East Arcade 2
cartridges.description: Data East Arcade 2 brings players 12 more all-action arcade classics from Data East’s extensive back catalogue. Includes the cinematic action of Edward Randy, the prehistoric platforming of Joe & Mac Returns, the offbeat craziness of Trio The Punch: Never Forget Me… and many more!

games.title: Peter Pepper's Ice Cream Factory
games.description: BurgerTime star Peter Pepper is back, and this time he's making delicious desserts! Roll and kick the scoops of ice cream to complete cones and defeat your enemies in this tricky '80s arcade classic for Evercade.

games.title: B-Wings
games.description: Blast off to victory in this innovative '80s Data East arcade shoot 'em up for Evercade! Upgrade your ship with special "WING" modules, and if the action gets a bit hectic at altitude, dive into the background for a moment's respite!

games.title: Shoot Out
games.description: Dish out some vigilante justice against the Mob Boss in this Data East gallery shooter arcade game for Evercade. Hit the target range for some practice, then take to the streets to blow away some bad guys!

games.title: Last Mission
games.description: Battle to regain your honour in this multidirectional arcade shoot 'em up from Data East, now on Evercade. Fend off your foes with four powerful weapons, and beware the deadly bosses!

games.title: Express Raider
games.description: You're a train robber in the Old West in this all-action Data East arcade classic for Evercade. Fight and shoot your way past hordes of enemies and keep your eye on the prize!

games.title: SRD: Super Real Darwin
games.description: It's survival of the fittest in this vertical scrolling arcade classic from Data East, now on Evercade. Evolve your ship with power-ups and hold out as long as you can against overwhelming odds!

games.title: Midnight Resistance
games.description: Your family's been kidnapped by King Crimson, and a whole army of bad guys is standing in your way. Warm up that trigger finger for run and gun arcade action from Data East, now on Evercade.

games.title: Crude Buster
games.description: When New York is hit by a nuke and overrun by terrorists, you're the only dude crude enough to save the city! Punch, kick and even hurl scenery items at your enemies in this Data East arcade beat 'em up classic for Evercade.

games.title: Trio the Punch: Never Forget Me…
games.description: Trio the Punch: Never Forget Me… is one of Data East's most notoriously off-the-wall arcade games. Fight your way through 35 stages and enjoy the hilarious chaos for yourself on Evercade!

games.title: Super BurgerTime
games.description: Peter Pepper Jr. hopes to follow in the footsteps of his father by building the best burgers around! Help our heroic chef on his quest in this Data East arcade classic for Evercade.

games.title: Edward Randy
games.description: Drawing inspiration from classic action movies, Edward Randy is a cinematic arcade action thriller from Data East, now for Evercade. Battle the forces of Dark Ogre and prevent him from launching a deadly weapon of mass destruction!

games.title: Joe & Mac Returns
games.description: The Caveman Ninja are back! Bash the baddies and save the cavewomen in this colourful Data East arcade elimination platformer on Evercade.

cartridges.title: Toaplan Arcade 3
cartridges.description: Toaplan Arcade 3 for Evercade brings together 7 all-time classic arcade hits from the legendary Japanese developer Toaplan. Discover the origins of the “bullet hell” subgenre with Batsugun and its Special Version variant; run and gun with Out Zone and FixEight; take the controls of the HyperFighter in explosive sequel Truxton II; blast your way through enemies and environments inspired by Indian mythology in Vimana; and bust some blocks with Ghox!

games.title: Batsugun
games.description: Discover the roots of the popular "danmaku" shoot 'em up subgenre with Toaplan's classic Batsugun, now on Evercade!

games.title: Batsugun Special Version
games.description: Batsugun's Special Version rebalances the shoot 'em up classic's gameplay and adds some new mechanics. Enjoy both versions of this arcade hit on Evercade!

games.title: Out Zone
games.description: Toaplan turns its attention to top-down run and gun shoot 'em up action with Out Zone. You'll need brains as well as brawn to conquer this challenge on Evercade!

games.title: FixEight
games.description: Blast your way through Toaplan's spiritual successor to Out Zone on Evercade. Eight heavily armed playable characters await your command on this mission of destruction!

games.title: Truxton II
games.description: Truxton's back on Evercade with this explosive arcade sequel from Toaplan. Take the controls of the HyperFighter and blast your way through enemy forces with a selection of powerful weaponry!

games.title: Ghox
games.description: Bust some blocks with Ghox! This challenging fantasy-themed block-breaking bat-and-ball game from Toaplan comes home for the first time on Evercade.

games.title: Vimana
games.description: Inspired by Indian mythology, Vimana brings accessible and beginner-friendly shoot 'em up action to Evercade. Fight back against your foes with powerful shots and the innovative Circle Bomb system!

cartridges.title: Legacy of Kain Collection
cartridges.description: Legacy of Kain Collection for Evercade features the two games that launched the classic Legacy of Kain saga from Crystal Dynamics. Follow the vampire Kain on a quest for revenge in Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain, and in Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver, the wraith Raziel seeks to strike back at his former master.

games.title: Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain
games.description: "Nothing is free. Not even revenge." Discover the truth behind these words in this 32-bit classic for Evercade. Guide the vampire Kain on his quest for vengeance against his murderers in an epic role-playing adventure filled with dark deeds and brooding atmosphere. Read More...

games.title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
games.description: In this 32-bit Gothic horror classic for Evercade, the vampire Raziel was executed for the deadly sin of evolving before his master Kain. Now returned as a wraith, he seeks to take down the one he once called "Master". Shift between the Material and Spectral Planes to solve puzzles and defeat your powerful foes.

cartridges.title: The Bitmap Brothers Collection 2
cartridges.description: The Bitmap Brothers Collection 2 for Evercade brings together five home computer classics from the self-appointed “rock stars” of the British game development scene, including Cadaver and its expansion The Payoff, Gods, Magic Pockets and The Chaos Engine 2, plus the 32-bit home console version of real-time strategy classic Z!

games.title: Cadaver
games.description: In Cadaver for Evercade, you'll take control of Karadoc the dwarf on his mission to defeat an evil necromancer. Blending elements of adventure and role-playing games, this Amiga classic features a quest that will tax both brain and brawn!

games.title: Cadaver: The Payoff
games.description: Fresh from his mission to defeat Dianos the necromancer, Karadoc the dwarf returns in this expansion for Cadaver on Evercade. Four huge new levels await our hero in this Amiga adventure, each packed with tricks, traps and puzzles to overcome!

games.title: Gods
games.description: Classic Amiga platformer Gods comes to Evercade! Take on the role of a legendary hero who dares to challenge the Gods on their own turf. Fight and puzzle your way through four areas of an ancient city on your quest to take a seat atop Mount Olympus.

games.title: Magic Pockets
games.description: Delve into the mysteries that lie within your own trousers in Magic Pockets, an attitude-filled Amiga platformer. As the cooler-than-cool Bitmap Kid, it's up to you to reclaim your Best Toys from the Bad People — and fill up on Sweet Things in the process!

games.title: The Chaos Engine 2
games.description: Amiga action star The Chaos Engine 2 swaps the cooperative gameplay of its predecessor in favour of split-screen objective-based competitive action. Battle against a computer-controlled opponent in a series of missions to win your freedom, or compete against a friend on Evercade VS!

games.title: Z
games.description: Eat lead… with Z! This 32-bit real-time strategy classic places a strong emphasis on territory control. As an army of red robots, battle against your blue rivals for supremacy. Aggression is the name of the game, because your opponent certainly isn't going to wait for you!

cartridges.title: Thalamus Collection 1
cartridges.description: Thalamus Collection 1 brings some of the all-time best home computer games to Evercade, including classics such as Creatures, Armalyte and Hunter’s Moon!

games.title: Hunter's Moon Remastered
games.description: Thalamus' classic multidirectional shooter Hunter's Moon comes to Evercade in its enhanced 2018 Remastered incarnation. Collect the Starcells and outwit the enemy hives on your quest to return home!

games.title: Armalyte: Competition Edition
games.description: Armalyte, regarded as one of the best horizontally scrolling shoot 'em ups on C64 and a highlight from Thalamus' library, blasts its way onto Evercade in its enhanced Competition Edition incarnation. Fight solo or bring a friend on Evercade VS for simultaneous blasting action!

games.title: Hawkeye
games.description: Hawkeye, developed by C64 demoscene veterans The Boys Without Brains, explodes onto Evercade. Take control of the synthetic life form Hawkeye and fight back against the Skryksis in Thalamus' all-action run-and-gun platformer!

games.title: Snare
games.description: Thalamus' C64 classic Snare arrives on Evercade, challenging you to think and fight your way through twenty levels of tricky maze action. Can you discover the secret that billionaire Andre Thelman concealed at the centre of the Snare?

games.title: Retrograde
games.description: Retrograde, Thalamus' spiritual successor to C64 classic Cyberdyne Warrior, comes to Evercade! Battle through the seven conquered planets of the Thwok system in an attempt to save your home from certain doom.

games.title: Creatures
games.description: One of Thalamus' most famous games comes to Evercade! Guide Clyde Radcliffe the Fuzzy Wuzzy on a quest to save his people from the demons who have captured them. Bounce through scrolling platformer stages, then puzzle your way out of the diabolical torture chambers!

games.title: Summer Camp
games.description: Maximus Mouse has a problem in this classic Thalamus C64 platformer for Evercade. The Stars and Stripes flag has been stolen! It's up to our hero to recover it across four huge levels of platforming, puzzling action.

games.title: Heatseeker
games.description: Widely regarded as one of Thalamus' most peculiar and intriguing C64 games, Heatseeker places you in control of the Leg and the Ball in a quest for thermal energy. The people of Tantris are relying on you to save their planet from environmental disaster!

games.title: Creatures II: Torture Trouble
games.description: The follow-up to the classic Creatures once again tasks Clyde Radcliffe with saving the Fuzzy Wuzzies from the demons' diabolical torture chambers. Enjoy Thalamus' mastery of the C64 with this challenging puzzle platformer!

games.title: Winter Camp
games.description: Maximus Mouse returns in Thalamus' genre-spanning C64 classic, now for Evercade. Across eight very different stages, our hero must prove his Rescue Ranger skills by saving anyone in trouble and preventing a deadly avalanche!

games.title: Nobby the Aardvark
games.description: Celebrate the history of Thalamus on Evercade with the company's final C64 game, Nobby the Aardvark. Guide our hero on a quest through time and space, featuring multiple gameplay styles and some of the best visuals on C64!

cartridges.title: Tomb Raider Collection 1
cartridges.description: A legend begins! Tomb Raider Collection 1 for Evercade includes the first three published adventures of the world’s most famous acrobatic archaeologist, including Tomb Raider, Tomb Raider II Starring Lara Croft and Tomb Raider III: Adventures of Lara Croft!
cartridges.note: £22.49/$24.99/€24.99 - Also included in Evercade VS-R and Evercade EXP-R console packs.

games.title: Tomb Raider
games.description: Tomb Raider brings Lara Croft's first published adventure to Evercade. Delve into unexplored ruins in search of a mystical artefact, but beware of ancient traps, perilous environments and the local wildlife!Read More...

games.title: Tomb Raider II Starring Lara Croft
games.description: Tomb Raider II comes to Evercade, chronicling Lara Croft's globetrotting quest for the Dagger of Xian. Visit the Great Wall of China, the canals of Venice, the mountains of Tibet and even the ocean floor in search of the truth behind the legend. Read More...

games.title: Tomb Raider III: Adventures of Lara Croft
games.description: In Tomb Raider III for Evercade, Lara Croft sets off on another adventure around the world, this time taking in the jungles of India, islands in the South Pacific, the deserts of Nevada, the streets of London and even the frozen wastes of Antarctica.

cartridges.title: Piko Interactive Collection 4
cartridges.description: Piko Interactive Collection 4 brings together 10 great games that span the 8 to 64-bit eras, including 3D platformer Glover, the atmospheric Risky Woods, Randell Reiss’ impressive 16-bit first-person shooter Zero Tolerance Underground and more!

games.title: Glover (64-bit)
games.description: Charming 64-bit 3D platformer action comes to Evercade with Glover and his ball-bouncing quest to recover the Crystal Castle's most precious treasures.

games.title: Risky Woods
games.description: The wise old monks of the land have been turned into statues, and it's up to the brave young warrior Rohan to save them in Risky Woods, an atmospheric 16-bit platformer for Evercade.

games.title: Zero Tolerance Underground
games.description: In this impressive 16-bit first-person shooter by Randel Reiss, it's up to you to prevent an alien invasion from destroying the world's transport infrastructure. Your Evercade is up to the challenge — are you?

games.title: Street Racer
games.description: Kart racing comes to Evercade with a violent twist in Street Racer, a thrilling 16-bit title featuring split-screen action for up to four players!

games.title: Target: Renegade
games.description: It's time to clean up the mean streets once again in this classic 8-bit brawler for Evercade. Can you beat Mr. Big?

games.title: Sküljagger: Revolt of the Westicans
games.description: For ten years, the evil Sküljagger has ruled the island of Westica with an iron fist. Join the heroic Storm Jaxon in this 16-bit platforming adventure for Evercade as he attempts to overthrow the tyrant.

games.title: Bad Street Brawler
games.description: Bop'n rumble your way through the mean streets as former punk rocker and super-cool martial arts vigilante Duke Davis in this 8-bit brawler for Evercade.

games.title: Mermaids of Atlantis
games.description: Strategically pop bubbles and make use of mysterious magic powers in this aquatic-themed 8-bit puzzler for Evercade.

games.title: Star X
games.description: The race is on to save all of humanity from enslavement by an alien race in this 32-bit polygonal shoot 'em up for Evercade!

games.title: The Fidgetts
games.description: Freddie and Frankie Fidgett must make it back to the docks to reunite with their family, but they need your help in this 8-bit puzzle platformer for Evercade!

cartridges.title: Sunsoft Collection 2
cartridges.description: Sunsoft returns to Evercade with a selection of 7 big hits and cult classics. Includes Ufouria: The Saga, Blaster Master: Enemy Below, Aero the Acro-Bat 2, Zero the Kamikaze Squirrel, Daze Before Christmas, Galaxy Fight: Universal Warriors and the first localised release of Pri Pri Primitive Princess!

games.title: Blaster Master: Enemy Below
games.description: Hop back into the driver's seat of Sophia III for another trip underground in Blaster Master: Enemy Below, an 8-bit handheld take on Sunsoft's classic exploration platformer series.

games.title: Ufouria: The Saga
games.description: One of Sunsoft's most sought-after games comes to Evercade! In Ufouria: The Saga, four friends must work together to escape from a strange other world in an open-structure platforming adventure.

games.title: Daze Before Christmas
games.description: Take on the role of Santa in this festive Sunsoft platformer for Evercade, formerly an Australian and European exclusive. Recover the presents and save Christmas… or unleash the Anti-Claus to get all that rage out!

games.title: Aero the Acro-Bat 2
games.description: Aero the Acro-Bat 2 sees our platforming hero return to Evercade, only to be drawn into a strange and magical other world! Meanwhile, the evil Edgar Ektor is preparing his mysterious "Plan B"...

games.title: Zero the Kamikaze Squirrel
games.description: Zero the Kamikaze Squirrel sees Aero's greatest rival taking time out from playing the villain to save his forest homeland in a martial arts-themed platforming adventure for Evercade.

games.title: Pri Pri Primitive Princess!
games.description: This 8-bit handheld platforming puzzler was formerly exclusive to Japan, but now Evercade players the world over can enjoy our hero Totom's tricky quest to win the beautiful Pri Pri's hand in marriage. Read More...

games.title: Galaxy Fight: Universal Warriors
games.description: This sci-fi fighting game for Evercade is the precursor to Sunsoft's cult arcade hit Waku Waku 7. Featuring eight crazy characters and stages without boundaries, be prepared for fierce battles against a colourful cast!

cartridges.title: THEC64 Collection 3
cartridges.description: 13 classic 8-bit home computer games come to Evercade, including sporting classic Summer Games II, popular puzzler Boulder Dash, cerebral shoot ’em up Heavy Metal Paradroid and many more.

games.title: Summer Games II
games.description: The classic C64 multi-sports series returns to Evercade with more fun in the sun. Test your skills in Triple Jump, Rowing, Javelin, Equestrian, High Jump, Fencing, Cycling and Kayaking.

games.title: Boulder Dash
games.description: Legendary C64 classic Boulder Dash comes to Evercade. Guide the adventurer Rockford in his quest for diamonds through five difficulty levels of 16 brain-taxing caves each!

games.title: Heavy Metal Paradroid
games.description: Andrew Braybrook's beloved cerebral shoot 'em up comes to Evercade. In Heavy Metal Paradroid, it's your job to save the day from a horde of droids gone wild! Read More...

games.title: Super Cycle
games.description: Hit the open road with C64 racer Super Cycle, now on Evercade. It's full throttle all the way as you compete against a pack of opponents… and some perilously varied road conditions!

games.title: Jumpman Junior
games.description: In this well-loved C64 platformer, now for Evercade, you'll leap and bound across the 12 levels of the Jupiter Command Substation as you attempt to defuse the Alienators' bombs.

games.title: Cyberdyne Warrior
games.description: The challenging C64 platformer comes to Evercade. Explore three dangerous planets and track down the missing droids to return them to their prison satellites.

games.title: Cybernoid II: The Revenge
games.description: The tricky C64 exploratory shoot 'em up arrives on Evercade. Infiltrate a pirate base and retrieve the stolen goods, causing plenty of destruction along the way!

games.title: Netherworld
games.description: This multi-scrolling shoot 'em up for C64 shines on Evercade. Trapped in another dimension, the only way back is to collect enough diamonds to find your way home.

games.title: Deliverance: Stormlord II
games.description: This challenging platformer, renowned for its impressive graphics on C64, comes to Evercade. Can you rescue the imprisoned fairies from a series of hellish environments?

games.title: Anarchy
