games.description: Combining shoot 'em up and puzzle action, Anarchy is another classic C64 title arriving on Evercade. Drive your A.C.E. Mk2 Interceptor unit to quash a rebellion, but watch out for security droids!

games.title: Exolon
games.description: This well-regarded but tricky C64 platformer is sure to keep you busy on Evercade. Blast your way through alien hordes and keep an eye out for the precious Hyper-Alloy Exoskeleton!

games.title: Street Sports Soccer
games.description: Take to the streets and kick off a game of urban soccer in this C64 sporting classic, now for Evercade. Challenge a computer-controlled opponent or play against a friend!

games.title: Break Dance
games.description: This C64 classic about street dancing culture challenges you to show your best moves on Evercade. Have you got the juice or will you get burned?

cartridges.title: Indie Heroes Collection 3
cartridges.description:
Indie Heroes Collection 3 for Evercade includes 13 great games developed by modern creators working with vintage platforms or simply in the retro style. Includes the incredible arcade-style hit Donut Dodo, the platforming action of Thunder Paw, Magic and Legend: Time Knights, Doodle World Redrawn, Bubble Seahorse Adventures, Orebody: Binder’s Tale and Skate Cat, plus the tricky puzzling of Big2Small, Alien Cat 2, Bone Marrow and Chew Chew Mimic!
Please note: The game “Bubble Seahorse Adventures” on this cartridge is not presently compatible with Evercade EXP-R and Alpha devices.

games.title: Donut Dodo
games.description: The fantastic Donut Dodo from pixel.games gets a native Evercade port for Indie Heroes Collection 3. Paying homage to arcade classics of the early '80s, this single-screen platformer will keep you chasing high scores until the small hours.Read More...

games.title: Thunder Paw
games.description: In Thunder Paw, you'll take angry (and heavily armed) pupper Thunder through a series of dangerous levels on his epic quest to rescue his parents. Challenging platforming and plenty of secrets await!Read More...

games.title: Big2Small
games.description: The animals are hungry in this colourful puzzler for Evercade! Guide Elle the Elephant, Gisele the Goat and Melanie the Mouse to their favourite foods — it sounds easy, but you'll need to think carefully if you want to beat the tricky par scores!Read More...

games.title: Magic and Legend: Time Knights
games.description: Magic and Legend are ordinary kids thrown into extraordinary circumstances in this platform action game for Evercade. Hop through time and use various weapons to take on an alien threat that seeks to destroy Earth's history!Read More...

games.title: Doodle World Redrawn
games.description: The enhanced and expanded version of homebrew hit Doodle World comes to Evercade! Challenge a tricky platforming quest with your all-new double jump ability.Read More...

games.title: The Little Tales of Alexandria
games.description: In this story-based adventure game for Evercade, you've just moved into a new apartment complex. It's time to get to know your new neighbours — you might be surprised what you'll learn!

games.title: Alien Cat 2: Enhanced Edition
games.description: Alien Cat returns in this enhanced, expanded version of his tricky puzzle adventure for Evercade. Dodge traps to collect the spaceship parts, but keep a careful eye on your clones!

games.title: Bubble Seahorse Adventures
games.description: You're a seahorse, and you want to go to the moon! Don't ask silly questions like "why?", just grab your Evercade and prepare for a bubble-popping, enemy-hopping adventure!Read More...

games.title: Orebody: Binder's Tale
games.description: In this all-action 8-bit platformer for Evercade, you'll take on the role of Binder the robot. His mission: discover the truth behind the grudge his former masters hold towards humanity!Read More...

games.title: Skate Cat
games.description: Monsters have invaded the planet, and only one cool cat can save the day in this fun platformer for Evercade! Skate through varied levels, and upgrade your board to better fight the demonic threat.

games.title: Bone Marrow
games.description: Forward planning is the name of the game in this Evercade title that combines puzzle, strategy and RPG elements. Prepare your items by night and use them to defeat monsters in the day!Read More...

games.title: Chibi Monster Br4wl
games.description: It's chaos for up to 4 players on Evercade VS with this all-action single-screen platformer. As a member of the undead, compete against your fellow monsters to snag boogly boo berries and satisfy your endless hunger!

games.title: Chew Chew Mimic
games.description: In this comedic puzzle game for Evercade, the knights are in search of treasure and the Mimic is in search of its next meal. It's your job to satisfy them both with some carefully placed puzzle pieces!Read More...

cartridges.title: Demons of Asteborg/Astebros
cartridges.description: Discover the legends of Asteborg in two fantastic 16-bit games for Evercade. Fight back the demon invasion in Demons of Asteborg, and discover the origins of Asteborg in the roguelite platform adventure Astebros.

games.title: Demons of Asteborg
games.description: Demons of Asteborg is one of the most impressive 16-bit titles available on Evercade. As the heroic Gareth, fight back against the demonic hordes and defend your homeland in this challenging, all-action platformer!

games.title: Astebros
games.description: Astebros is a visually gorgeous 16-bit roguelite action platformer for Evercade. Discover the origins of Asteborg as you explore randomly generated dungeons and battle fearsome foes as three playable characters!

cartridges.title: Goodboy Galaxy/Witch n' Wiz
cartridges.description: The Goodboy Galaxy/Witch n’ Wiz dual cartridge for Evercade features two grand adventures to enjoy on your Evercade systems. In Goodboy Galaxy, you’ll take to the stars as Maxwell the dog as you seek to repair his broken hyperdrive. And in Witch n’ Wiz, you’ll tackle devious puzzles on a quest to save your childhood friend from a magical fate!

games.title: Goodboy Galaxy
games.description: Take on the role of Maxwell the dog in Goodboy Galaxy, one of the best exploration platformers on Evercade. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies and make new friends on your quest to repair your spaceship!

games.title: Witch n' Wiz
games.description: In Witch n' Wiz, an 8-bit puzzle adventure for Evercade, you'll delve into perilous dungeons in search of your childhood friend. Brains rather than brawn will save the day on this adventure, though!

cartridges.title: Duke Nukem Collection 2
cartridges.description: Duke Nukem’s three 32-bit adventures come to Evercade, featuring the time-travelling mayhem of Duke Nukem: Time to Kill, the futuristic alien gorilla-blasting of Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes, and the impressive handheld FPS action of Duke Nukem Advance.

games.title: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill
games.description: Duke Nukem's first 32-bit adventure blasts on to Evercade! The evil Drak forces are causing havoc in the Earth's timeline, and it's up to Duke to set things right in his own inimitable style. Cause carnage in the present day, the Old West, medieval Europe and ancient Rome! Read More...

games.title: Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes
games.description: Duke Nukem's second 32-bit outing, now on Evercade, sees our hero supporting the Unified Babe Resistance as they fight back against the alien forces who have exterminated all the men on Earth! The future of the human race is at stake... Read More...

games.title: Duke Nukem Advance
games.description: Duke Nukem's ambitious handheld adventure comes to Evercade! Our hero is sent to investigate Area 51 after reports of yet another alien species attempting to invade the planet. A globetrotting first-person action thriller awaits as our hero attempts to discover the truth behind the latest threat to humanity's existence. Read More...

cartridges.title: Duke Nukem Collection 1
cartridges.description: Hail to the King, baby! Duke Nukem’s first three adventures come to Evercade in style, including fully remastered versions of Duke Nukem 1 and 2, plus first-person shooter classic Duke Nukem 3D!

games.title: Duke Nukem: Remastered
games.description: Duke Nukem's first outing, originally released in 1991 and newly remastered for Evercade, is an all-action platformer in which our hero chases down the dastardly Dr. Proton across a devastated Los Angeles and a secret moonbase... and onwards through time into the future! Read More...

games.title: Duke Nukem II: Remastered
games.description: A year after foiling Dr. Proton's nefarious plans, Duke Nukem is kidnapped by the evil Rigelatin forces, who intend to use his brain to plot their invasion of the Earth. First released in 1993 and newly remastered for Evercade, Duke Nukem II is a platform adventure filled with explosive action! Read More...

games.title: Duke Nukem 3D: Total Meltdown
games.description: The 32-bit version of Duke Nukem's most famous mission comes to Evercade! Blast your way through the seedy underbelly of Los Angeles and onwards into the heart of an alien invasion force, wielding a variety of crazy weaponry and a bottomless supply of one-liners. Read More...

cartridges.title: Home Computer Heroes Collection 1
cartridges.description: Home Computer Heroes Collection 1 for Evercade brings the Indie Heroes philosophy to the home computer space! Enjoy seven “modern retro” titles designed for classic home computers on Evercade, including Planet X2 and Attack of the PETSCII Robots by The 8-Bit Guy, the official C64 version of the beloved Farming Simulator series, our first MSX title, The Sword of Ianna, plus Tanks Furry and Bridge Strike from Amiga demoscene veterans Project R3D.

games.title: Attack of the PETSCII Robots
games.description: Attack of the PETSCII Robots, seen on Evercade in its Amiga incarnation, is an exciting combination of action and strategy in which your job sounds simple: eliminate all the robots. But this is no simple blastathon; you'll need to use brains as well as brawn to overcome your deadly mechanical foes!

games.title: Planet X2
games.description: In real-time strategy game Planet X2, originally released for C64, you're in charge of a planetary colonisation effort, and the Evercade is your command centre. But watch out! You're not alone, and your new friends planetside don't like sharing… Read More...

games.title: Farming Simulator: C64 Edition
games.description: The much loved Farming Simulator series comes to 8-bit home computers! Your goal is straightforward: make as much profit as you can without running out of fuel, seeds or funding. Take control of four powerful pieces of farming machinery and live the modern farming life on Evercade.

games.title: The Sword of Ianna
games.description: The Sword of Ianna is an 8-bit action adventure, originally designed for the classic MSX platform and now available on Evercade. Guide the brave Jarkum on his beautifully animated quest to overcome chaos and restore order in the name of the goddess Ianna. Read More...

games.title: Citadel Remonstered
games.description: Atmospheric first-person shooter Citadel was originally released for Amiga home computers in 1995, where it wowed critics and players alike with its challenging sci-fi action. This enhanced, expanded "Remonstered" version was first released in 2022, and is now available to enjoy on Evercade.

games.title: Tanks Furry
games.description: Strap in and prepare for an armoured battle in this all-action arcade-style Amiga game, now available for Evercade. Play solo or in cooperation with a friend as you fend off the vicious mole forces in the main game mode, or compete against up to three friends in frantic versus mode battles!

games.title: Bridge Strike
games.description: There's only one thing to do with a river full of enemy forces: raid it! This arcade-style Amiga game, now available for Evercade, puts you at the controls of a powerful jet fighter as you battle against foes in the air, on the ground and in the water — and contend with highly variable, dangerous weather conditions, too.

cartridges.title: Full Void
cartridges.description: Full Void by OutOfTheBit is a modern indie title for Evercade, heavily inspired by classic 16-bit cinematic puzzle platformers. Taking on the role of a nameless teenager in a futuristic dystopia, you must fight back against the rogue AI that has enslaved humanity!

editions.title: Full Void Special Edition
editions.description: Also released was the Full Void Special Edition. Complete with the included comic from the standard edition, this Special Edition also includes an exclusive blue coloured cartridge, stickers, poster, an exclusive cart inlay and an art book, all in one cardboard sleeve.

games.title: Full Void
games.description: In the future, all of humanity has been enslaved by a rogue AI. All? Well, not quite… one brave teenager, scared and alone in this dark dystopia, sets off on a quest to battle for their freedom. Explore beautiful pixel art locales and enjoy hand-drawn animations in Full Void, a gorgeous modern indie title for Evercade, inspired by the cinematic classics of the past. Read More...

cartridges.title: Delphine Software Collection 1
cartridges.description:
Enjoy three stunning Amiga classics and a console gaming legend from the cinematic masters of home computer games, Delphine Software. Travel through time in Future Wars, unravel an international mystery in Operation Stealth, make first contact with an alien race in Another World and recover your identity in Flashback!
Need a hand getting started with these tricky games? Click here for a guide!

games.title: Another World
games.description: In Another World, one of Delphine Software's most beloved Amiga classics, scientist Lester Chaykin is having a very bad day at work. Can you help him out of his otherworldly predicament on Evercade?

games.title: Flashback
games.description: The console version of Delphine Software's stunning rotoscoped cinematic platformer comes to Evercade. Guide the amnesiac hero Conrad Hart in his quest to recover his identity… and uncover a deadly conspiracy along the way.

games.title: Future Wars
games.description: Even a humble window cleaner can save the universe in Future Wars! Enjoy this classic Amiga point-and-click adventure on the go for the first time with Evercade handhelds, or play it on the big screen with Evercade VS for a truly cinematic experience.

games.title: Operation Stealth
games.description: In Operation Stealth, someone has stolen a top-secret stealth aircraft — and it's up to you to get it back. The second of Delphine Software's "Cinematique" point-and-click Amiga adventures comes to Evercade!

cartridges.title: Sunsoft Collection 1
cartridges.description: Sunsoft Collection 1 brings together six classic games from the renowned Japanese developer, including cult hit Mr. Gimmick, 8-bit legend Blaster Master and many more!

games.title: Mr. Gimmick
games.description: This cult classic platformer was previously only released in Japan and Scandinavia. Now new fans all over the world can enjoy it on Evercade!

games.title: Blaster Master
games.description: The classic 8-bit exploration platformer Blaster Master comes to Evercade. Jump in the futuristic Sophia III battle tank and strike back against the deadly mutant bosses!

games.title: Blaster Master Boy
games.description: In Blaster Master Boy for Evercade, you'll leave the safety of Sophia III to once again take on the mutant bosses… and this time you've come armed with a plethora of heavy explosives!

games.title: Aero the Acro-Bat
games.description: Sunsoft's charming mascot platformer Aero the Acro-Bat comes to Evercade in style. Can you save the World of Amusement Circus and Funpark?

games.title: Journey to Silius
games.description: Journey to Silius is an all-action run-and-gun for Evercade in which you take on the terrorists who have ruined a space colony. No enemy is too big for you and your arsenal of heavy weapons!

games.title: Arabian
games.description: Princess Leia (not that one) has been kidnapped by an evil army! In Arabian for Evercade, it's your job as the Persian prince (not that one either) to save the day with the power of the magic pots.

cartridges.title: PIKO Interactive Arcade 1
cartridges.description: Piko Interactive Arcade 1 features 9 unusual, varied and rare arcade games from the mid to late 1990s, including Dragon Master, Master’s Fury, Fancy World: Earth of Crisis, Magic Purple, The Legend of Silkroad and Burglar X from Korean developer Unico, plus Art & Magic’s visually impressive sports title Ultimate Tennis, and Steel Force and Diver Boy from Electronic Devices Italy.

games.title: Dragon Master
games.description: Get ready for some intense fighting action on Evercade with Dragon Master from Korean developer Unico, featuring eight playable fighters and three deadly bosses to challenge.

games.title: Master's Fury
games.description: Rarely seen in the wild, Unico's one-on-one fighter Master's Fury finally gets an official home release on Evercade. Prepare for a furious battle as one of ten playable characters!

games.title: Fancy World: Earth of Crisis
games.description: In Fancy World, the Earth is in crisis once again, and it's up to our cat-eared heroine and her headband-wearing friend to save the day in this colourful arcade platformer for Evercade.

games.title: The Legend of Silkroad
games.description: Unico's visually striking beat 'em up The Legend of Silkroad comes to Evercade. As one of three playable characters, battle your way through nine challenging stages using special moves and magic to even the odds.

games.title: Burglar X
games.description: Burglar X is a cartoony maze romp, now on Evercade! Smash objects to find the shiny coins within, watch out for the enemies chasing you down… and if worst comes to worst, resort to weaponised flatulence.

games.title: Ultimate Tennis
games.description: Art & Magic's visually stunning tennis arcade game comes to Evercade. Compete in a variety of world-famous tennis challenges against computer-controlled opponents or a friend. Includes a handy beginner mode for tennis newbies!

games.title: Magic Purple
games.description: Magic Purple is a vibrant elimination platformer for Evercade. Battle through six worlds and a host of weird and wonderful enemies as an anthropomorphic duck with a penchant for punching.

games.title: Steel Force
games.description: Top-down action adventure Steel Force brings a sci-fi race against time to Evercade. Battle your way through space pirates and alien invaders, and beware of deadly traps!

games.title: Diver Boy
games.description: It's better down where it's wetter in this arcade action game for Evercade. Dive beneath the waves in search of precious pearls, but watch out for marine life looking to ruin your day!

cartridges.title: Sydney Hunter Collection
cartridges.description: The Sydney Hunter Collection brings together four great titles from CollectorVision Games, each originally released for a different classic retro gaming platform. Includes Sydney Hunter and the Shrines of Peril, Sydney Hunter and the Sacred Tribe, Sydney Hunter and the Caverns of Death, and Jester.
cartridges.note: This is now an Evercade Legacy Collection and is no longer in production.

games.title: Sydney Hunter and the Shrines of Peril
games.description: In the first Sydney Hunter game for Evercade, our hero is in search of precious gems hidden in Mayan temples. But the road to each temple is fraught with peril and dangerous creatures!

games.title: Sydney Hunter and the Sacred Tribe
games.description: This 8-bit Sydney Hunter adventure for Evercade challenges you to explore a vast temple in search of precious gems and open the Sacred Door. Many traps and treasures await!

games.title: Sydney Hunter and the Caverns of Death
games.description: This 16-bit Sydney Hunter adventure for Evercade finds our hero trapped inside Mt. Doom just as the god of the volcano is about to awaken. Can Sydney avoid becoming a human sacrifice?

games.title: Jester
games.description: This 8-bit maze game for Evercade challenges you to recover sacred treasures from a series of dungeons. Watch out for the deadly guards - and take care not to let your torch burn out!

cartridges.title: Team17 Collection 1
cartridges.description: Team17 Collection 1 for Evercade brings together a diverse selection of 16-bit home computer classics first published on Amiga, including the atmospheric sci-fi shooters of the Alien Breed series, the bone-crunching fighting of Body Blows, the accessible sporting action of Arcade Pool and Kingpin, and much more!
cartridges.note: Team17 Collection 1 is Compatible with all Evercade systems running Firmware version 3.0.X or above. Please update your system by updating on your console or by visiting evercade.co.uk/support for more information.

games.title: Full Contact
games.description: Team17's first Amiga game Full Contact comes to Evercade. In this fighting game, you'll battle against the ruthless Triad gang in the single-player mode, take on a friend in the versus challenge, or compete against up to 15 friends in the Tournament mode!

games.title: Alien Breed Special Edition
games.description: Alien Breed, one of Team17's most well-loved Amiga series, comes to Evercade! Explore, gather equipment and stockpile resources, but be ready for when those alien beasties start coming through the vents…

games.title: Body Blows
games.description: Team17's Amiga-based take on the one-on-one fighting genre hits Evercade! Challenge the single-player mode with one of the four hero characters, or compete against friends in the versus and tournament modes.

games.title: Project-X Special Edition
games.description: A classic Team17 scrolling shooter for Amiga blasts its way onto Evercade! Power up your weapons as you take on the biomechanical hordes of the planet Ryxx, and save humanity from yet another mess of its own creation.

games.title: Qwak
games.description: Team17's cartoony Amiga platformer Qwak bounces on to Evercade! Travel through eight worlds collecting keys, fruit, eggs and other treasure. Cooperate or compete with a friend in the simultaneous two-player mode!

games.title: Alien Breed II: The Horror Continues
games.description: The second entry in Team17's classic Alien Breed series for Amiga comes to Evercade. In Alien Breed II: The Horror Continues, the aliens are invading the Federation colony Alpha Five. Can you save the day… or is it already too late?

games.title: Arcade Pool
games.description: Team17's Amiga adaptation of the world's second-favourite pub activity comes to Evercade. In Arcade Pool, you can choose from a variety of different types of game, ranging from standard 8-ball and 9-ball rules up to arcade-style Speed Pool and trick shot challenges!

games.title: Alien Breed: Tower Assault
games.description: The third entry in Team17's classic series of sci-fi horror Amiga games creeps onto Evercade. Adopting a more non-linear structure, your job in Alien Breed: Tower Assault is to explore the towers of a military installation, locate and destroy the alien queen… then blow the place sky-high!

games.title: ATR: All-Terrain Racing
games.description: Team17's arcade-style racing game for Amiga crashes onto Evercade with style. Take on fearsome computer opponents and upgrade your car in single player, or compete against a friend in the score-based two-player mode.

games.title: Kingpin: Arcade Sports Series Bowling
games.description: Hit the lanes with Kingpin, a classic Amiga sporting simulation from Team17, now for Evercade! Compete for a high score solo, or take on up to five friends in challenging ten-pin bowling matches with a variety of customisable options.

cartridges.title: PIKO Interactive Collection 3
cartridges.description: Piko Interactive Collection 3 for Evercade brings together a diverse range of games, including whimsical 32-bit platformer 40 Winks, the technically impressive 16-bit first-person shooter Zero Tolerance, epic 16-bit RPG Legend of Wukong and many more!

games.title: 40 Winks
games.description: Classic 32-bit 3D platformer 40 Winks comes to Evercade. Combining the comical with the macabre, there'll be no sleep till you finish this one!

games.title: Zero Tolerance
games.description: First-person shooters didn't really hit their stride until the 32-bit era, but Zero Tolerance, now available on Evercade, showed that 16-bit platforms could handle this popular genre just fine!

games.title: Legend of Wukong
games.description: A modern reimagining of the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West, Legend of Wukong is an epic 16-bit RPG, now available to enjoy with a full English translation on Evercade!

games.title: Stanley: The Search for Dr. Livingston
games.description: It's a jungle out there in Stanley: The Search for Dr. Livingston, an 8-bit adventure for Evercade. As Stanley, it's your job to track down the renowned but eccentric Dr. Livingston somewhere in the depths of the Congolese wilderness.

games.title: Super Bubble Pop
games.description: Let's get poppin' in this upbeat 32-bit puzzler for Evercade! In Super Bubble Pop, you'll groove to the beat while matching and clearing the ever-advancing stacks of coloured bubbles.

games.title: Metal Mech: Man & Machine
games.description: Huge stompy robots and their tiny occupants come to Evercade with the action-packed 8-bit game Metal Mech: Man & Machine. As the heroic Tony Martin, it's your job to fight off the invading biomechanical hordes both on foot and in your walking battle tank!

games.title: Radikal Bikers
games.description: This previously unreleased 8-bit reimagining of a classic arcade game hits Evercade in style! In Radikal Bikers, you'll hit the streets on brightly coloured motor scooters and deliver pizza, compete against the clock or race against rivals.

games.title: Motor City Patrol
games.description: Crime is the disease and you're the cure in this 8-bit driving game for Evercade. In Motor City Patrol, your job is to keep the streets safe, be it from those simply driving dangerously or those committing more serious crimes!

games.title: Punch King
games.description: Punch King brings 32-bit arcade boxing to Evercade! As up-and-coming boxer Tiger Armstrong, you have a long road ahead of you to claim the title of Punch King, so you'd better get training!

games.title: Sword of Sodan
games.description: This graphically impressive 16-bit beat 'em up hacks and slashes its way onto Evercade! As the heroic Brodan or Shardan, your target is the evil necromancer Zoras. Armed with the Sword of Sodan, can you defeat the tyrant and reclaim the throne he usurped from your father? Read More...

cartridges.title: THEC64 Collection 2
cartridges.description: TheC64 Collection 2 brings 14 8-bit home computer classics from the beloved C64 platform to Evercade. Includes California Games, World Games, Impossible Mission II, Pitstop II, Uridium, Cybernoid and more!

games.title: World Games
games.description: World Games brings international C64 sports competition to Evercade! Compete in a variety of indoor and outdoor sports ranging from weightlifting to bull riding.

games.title: California Games
games.description: California Games is the gnarliest, most radical C64 sports competition on Evercade, dude! Prove how totally tubular you are with surfing, skateboarding, BMX biking, roller skating, foot bag and the flying disk!

games.title: Impossible Mission II
games.description: Dr. Elvin Atombender is causing trouble again in Impossible Mission II, another C64 classic for Evercade. Infiltrate Elvin's towers, crack numerical codes and uncover the musical password that will lead you to victory!

games.title: Pitstop II
games.description: The race is on in this high-speed C64 classic for Evercade. Challenge the computer to a race or championship, or take on a friend in split-screen action on Evercade VS. Remember you're in charge of the pit crew as well as the driving!

games.title: Sword of Fargoal
games.description: Sword of Fargoal brings classic C64 dungeon-crawling action RPG action to Evercade. Delve into the dungeons in search of the famous weapon, gathering gold and training yourself along the way. Can you survive the challenges ahead? Read More...

games.title: Street Sports Basketball
games.description: Shoot some hoops on the street with Street Sports Basketball, a C64 sporting classic for Evercade! Build your team from a lineup of aspiring basketball superstars, then outwit your opponent on a variety of improvised courts. Compete against a friend on Evercade VS!

games.title: Uridium
games.description: Uridium, a legendary C64 shoot 'em up, comes to Evercade! The Super Dreadnoughts are coming, and only you can stop them in your Manta fighter. Stay on target!

games.title: Cybernoid
games.description: Cybernoid, an intriguing blend of shoot 'em up and platformer action, is a favourite from the C64 library, now for Evercade. Can you retrieve the stolen Federation materials from the space pirates?

games.title: Nebulus
games.description: There are towers to topple, and you're the only one for the job in Nebulus, a challenging C64 platformer for Evercade. Climb to the top, blow the joint then escape in your mini-sub!

games.title: Firelord
games.description: In Firelord, a sprawling C64 action adventure for Evercade, it's your job to recover the Firestone from the Evil Queen. But there's four Charms of Eternal Youth to track down first… and plenty of other challenges along the way!

games.title: Slayer
games.description: Sometimes you just need a good, uncomplicated blastathon, and that's exactly what you get from Slayer, a horizontally scrolling C64 shoot 'em up for Evercade.

games.title: Zamzara
games.description: Zamzara is a challenging C64 platformer, now for Evercade. Can you escape from the depths of a laboratory complex before the deadly time bomb explodes?

games.title: Insects in Space
games.description: Insects in Space is an early C64 title from industry legends Sensible Software, casting you in the role of the laser-eyed angel Saint Helen. Enjoy the frantic blasting action on Evercade!

games.title: Mission Impossibubble
games.description: Mission Impossibubble, an exploration-centric C64 action game for Evercade, challenges you to solve the mystery of the teleporters, assemble mystical scrolls and rescue your friends!

cartridges.title: Toaplan Arcade 2
cartridges.description: Enjoy some of Toaplan’s finest arcade titles with this new collection of 7 games for Evercade. Includes side-scrollers Wardner and Demon’s World, top-down racer Rally Bike and legendary shoot ’em ups Twin Cobra, Twin Hawk, Fire Shark and Hellfire!

games.title: Fire Shark
games.description: One of Toaplan's most notoriously challenging shoot 'em ups comes to Evercade. Take on the Strange Fleet armada in Fire Shark, the world's most powerful biplane. If you can one-credit clear this one, you really know your shoot 'em up stuff.

games.title: Twin Cobra
games.description: Toaplan's follow-up to Tiger-Heli blasts onto Evercade! In Twin Cobra, you'll pilot the TC-7 Twin Cobra attack helicopter into a deadly war zone. Bring a friend for more firepower!

games.title: Twin Hawk
games.description: Toaplan's challenging vertically scrolling shoot 'em up comes to Evercade — and you're not alone in your mission this time. In Twin Hawk, you can summon a squadron of helpers to provide supporting fire at the touch of a button. Don't worry, you'll still get all of the glory.

games.title: Hellfire
games.description: Toaplan's first horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up hits Evercade! In Hellfire you'll blast your way through the forces of the evil Super Mech and his deadly Black Nebula space matter.

games.title: Rally Bike
games.description: Toaplan's vertically scrolling games often involve you blowing up everything in sight, but in Rally Bike you'll need to avoid causing chaos as you race across the United States! Don your helmet, grab your Evercade and get ready to race!

games.title: Wardner
games.description: Toaplan's challenging platformer Wardner comes to Evercade. Take on the role of the brave Dover as he attempts to rescue his friend Mia from an evil warlock!

games.title: Demon's World
games.description: Toaplan ain't afraid of no ghost, and you shouldn't be either in this supernatural platform shooter for Evercade. In Demon's World, you'll fend off the undead with your powerful weaponry — or just bounce on their heads if you're feeling particularly feisty.

cartridges.title: Indie Heroes Collection 2
cartridges.description: Indie Heroes Collection 2 brings together 12 great new games by talented independent developers from all over the world. Originally made for classic systems, this specially curated lineup showcases a variety of game styles and provides plenty of depth and variety to explore!

games.title: Tapeworm Disco Puzzle
games.description: Tapeworm Disco Puzzle is a puzzle game, and the companion piece to Flea! from the Indie Heroes Collection 1 cartridge for Evercade. Keep the beats banging while you help out your little hairy friends!

games.title: Nessy the Robot
games.description: Nessy the Robot is a platformer in classic 8-bit style, ready for you to enjoy on Evercade. But all is not quite as it seems in this colourful retro world!

games.title: Reknum Souls Adventure
games.description: Adventure through a world presented from both top-down and side-on perspectives in Reknum Souls Adventure, a sprawling 8-bit action RPG for Evercade.

games.title: The Cowlitz Gamers Adventure Trilogy
games.description: Originally released as a series of three 8-bit games sold in aid of charity, The Cowlitz Gamers Adventure Trilogy for Evercade will keep you on your toes with challenging precision platforming.

games.title: The Gruniożerca Trilogy
games.description: The Gruniożerca Trilogy for Evercade celebrates the life of Grunio, a beloved pet guinea pig who sadly departed this world in 2019. He will forever be remembered with this trilogy of challenging 8-bit puzzlers!

games.title: Anguna: Scourge of the Goblin King
games.description: Anguna: Scourge of the Goblin King is a non-linear open world 8-bit adventure for Evercade. Can you defeat the evil force threatening the realm?

games.title: Eyra, The Crow Maiden
games.description: Eyra, The Crow Maiden is a visually stunning 16-bit platformer for Evercade, in which the eponymous heroine is tasked with rescuing her village's warriors from the dread Infernal Marauder.

games.title: Beer Slinger
games.description: In Beer Slinger, a new 8-bit game for Evercade, you've just taken a job in the most popular bar in town. Can you keep up with customer demand for a full week?

games.title: Lunar Journey
games.description: Lunar Journey brings an adventure originally designed for a classic 8-bit handheld to Evercade. Can you track down the precious minerals to complete your mission?

games.title: Yeah Yeah Beebiss II
games.description: Yeah Yeah Beebiss II for Evercade is the 8-bit sequel to a video game that may or may not have existed — no-one really knows! At least we know this one's real.

games.title: Gelatinous: Humanity Lost
games.description: Gelatinous: Humanity Lost for Evercade sees you turned from a brave explorer into a puddle of sticky goo. Can you regain your humanity in this 8-bit platform adventure?

games.title: Nix: The Paradox Relic
games.description: Nix: The Paradox Relic for Evercade is an 8-bit action adventure in which you guide the eponymous bounty hunter on her quest to track down dangerous space pirates in an abandoned base.

cartridges.title: Toaplan Arcade 1
cartridges.description: The Toaplan Arcade 1 cartridge for Evercade features 8 classic arcade games from Toaplan, charting the history of this legendary developer through the ’80s and ’90s. Enjoy the top-tier shoot ’em up action of Tiger-Heli, Alcon, Flying Shark, Truxton and Zero Wing, then give your trigger finger a rest with action game Guardian, platformer Snow Bros. and puzzler Teki Paki!

games.title: Tiger-Heli
games.description: Tiger-Heli, one of Toaplan's earliest shoot 'em ups, blasts its way onto Evercade. Pilot your deadly chopper deep into enemy territory on a risky bombing mission and cause as much destruction as possible to your foes' ground and naval forces!

games.title: Alcon
games.description: Alcon, also known as Slap Fight, comes to Evercade in this collection. Pilot the Allied League of Cosmic Nations' SW475 space fighter craft and counterattack the invading aliens while enjoying the stirring soundtrack!

games.title: Guardian
games.description: Toaplan's side-scrolling action game Guardian comes to Evercade on this cartridge. Take control of a powerful combat robot, then punch and kick your way to victory!

games.title: Flying Shark
games.description: Toaplan's classic aerial shoot 'em up Flying Shark hits the Evercade! Pilot the eponymous blue biplane deep into enemy territory and cause chaos. You'll need quick-thinking strategy as well as skill to survive this dangerous mission! Read More...

games.title: Truxton
games.description: In legendary shoot 'em up Truxton, now on Evercade, you'll take on the role of ace pilot Tatsuo as you attempt to save your home world from Dogurava's forces. Grab new weapons and unleash the Truxton Bombs to even the odds!

games.title: Zero Wing
games.description: In Toaplan's classic Zero Wing, now for Evercade, somebody set up us the bomb and, we're reliably informed, all your base are belong to us. You have no chance to survive make your time. Take off every 'Zig'! You know what you doing. Move 'Zig'. For great justice! Read More...

games.title: Snow Bros.
games.description: Toaplan brings us a challenging single-screen platformer with Snow Bros., now for Evercade! As Nick and Tom, turn enemies into snowballs and give 'em a good kick to clear the screen!

games.title: Teki Paki
games.description: Teki Paki shows us Toaplan's take on the falling block puzzler, now for Evercade. Spin and drop pieces into position to make formations of five or more connected coloured blocks to progress. Simple but fiendishly addictive!

cartridges.title: IREM Arcade 1
cartridges.description: The Irem Arcade 1 cartridge for Evercade features 6 great arcade games from Irem, including early hits Moon Patrol and 10-Yard Fight, the legendary R-Type, the quirky Battle Chopper, the visually stunning In the Hunt and the first ever official home release of Lightning Swords.
cartridges.note: This cartridge is an Evercade Legacy Collection and is no longer in production.

games.title: R-Type
games.description: R-Type, one of the greatest shoot 'em ups ever created, comes to Evercade! This Irem classic will have you blasting off to strike the evil Bydo Empire time and time again. Read More...

games.title: Moon Patrol
games.description: Moon Patrol was one of Irem's first big hits thanks to its challenging gameplay and pioneering use of parallax scrolling. Enjoy this classic once more on Evercade!

games.title: In the Hunt
games.description: In the Hunt is Irem's visually stunning underwater shooter, challenging you (and perhaps a friend on Evercade VS) to save the world from a deadly doomsday weapon.

games.title: Battle Chopper
games.description: It's Mr. Heli's great adventure, now for Evercade! Explore caves, collect precious crystals, purchase power-ups and save the world from "The Muddy" in Irem's classic, Battle Chopper.

games.title: Lightning Swords
games.description: Irem's feudal Japan-themed epic, Lightning Swords, sees you fighting to avenge the death of Princess Orchid. This Evercade version is the first ever official home release of this game!

games.title: 10-Yard Fight
games.description: 10-Yard Fight is Irem's super-accessible take on American football, now for Evercade. Ditching all the complicated strategy, this is just about raw gridiron thrills!

cartridges.title: Alwa's Awakening 8-Bit Edition/Cathedral
cartridges.description:
In the Alwa’s Awakening and Cathedral cartridge for Evercade, you’ve got two huge exploration-heavy platform adventures ahead of you. Save the land of Alwa as the video game-loving Zoe in Alwa’s Awakening, and discover the truth behind an unnamed knight’s identity in the mysterious Cathedral.
Please note: The game “Cathedral” in this collection is not presently compatible with Evercade Alpha devices.

games.title: Alwa's Awakening
games.description: In Alwa's Awakening for Evercade, you play Zoe, an everyday sort of girl who just happens to enjoy video games. After dozing off playing games until the early hours, you find yourself in the land of Alwa — and apparently only you can save it from the nightmares in this sprawling platform adventure game!

games.title: Cathedral
games.description: In Cathedral for Evercade, you are a knight with no name, and you've awoken in an unfamiliar world. Can you uncover the truth behind your identity and defeat the fearsome guardians of the demi-god Ardur?

cartridges.title: THEC64 Collection 1
cartridges.description: THEC64 Collection 1 cartridge for Evercade brings the golden age of ’80s home computer games back for another round. Take on the world in thrilling sport action with Summer Games and Winter Games, indulge in some perilous platforming in Jumpman and take on the role of a martial arts master in Lee. Then “stay a while, stay forever” with Impossible Mission and a great selection of other big hits and deep cuts from THEC64’s extensive back catalogue!

games.title: Summer Games
games.description: Summer is here, and it's time for international sporting competition on Evercade! Show your Summer Games skills in a variety of disciplines including swimming, diving, gymnastics and athletics — and do your best to come out on top against up to seven of your friends.

games.title: Winter Games
games.description: Winter is coming, and what better way to celebrate it than with some snowy sporting fun? Winter Games allows up to eight players to compete against one another on Evercade, taking in disciplines ranging from the perilous ski jump to the majestic grace of figure skating.

games.title: Impossible Mission
games.description: "Another visitor! Stay a while, stay forever!" Dr. Elvin Atombender is preparing to blow up the world, and only you can stop him with your trusty Evercade. It's not going to be an easy task to get around his robots and discover his passwords — but we guess that's why they call it an Impossible Mission! Read More...

games.title: Jumpman
games.description: An all-time platforming classic comes to Evercade! As Jupiter Jumpman, it's your job to clear out the bombs left behind by the evil Alienators. There's some perilous gaps to leap ahead of you, but there's a good reason you're called Jumpman…

games.title: Lee
games.description: Take on the role of martial arts master Lee and search for the secret of immortality on Evercade. Gather the magic lanterns that will allow you to approach the mysterious wizard's lair — but watch out for the unwanted attentions of the spry ninja and the hulking Yamo, the latter of whom can be played by a friend!

games.title: Gateway to Apshai
games.description: One of the first ever action RPGs comes to Evercade! Tasked by the wizard Merlis with clearing a path to the mysterious Gateway to Apshai, you have eight levels, each with sixteen dungeons, between you and victory. Oh, but along the way there's treasure. Lots of treasure. Read More...

games.title: The Movie Monster Game
games.description: Take out your frustration on an entire city in The Movie Monster Game for Evercade! Choose your gigantic warrior, then take on a variety of challenges around the globe in this classic B-movie inspired action game.

games.title: Marauder
games.description: Marauder is a thrilling C64 shoot 'em up, now making a grand comeback on Evercade. As Captain C.T. Cobra, pilot your Marauder battlecar into the depths of the planet Mergatron in an attempt to retrieve the Jewels of Ozymandias from the ruins of a long-lost civilisation.

games.title: Stormlord
games.description: Stormlord's classic arcade adventure action comes to Evercade! Defend Stormland from the evil queen, and rescue the fairies she has captured along the way. Make clever use of the items you find along the way — you'll need brains as well as brawn here.

games.title: Subterranea
games.description: Subterranea, now for Evercade, challenges you to blast your way through 16 increasingly challenging caverns of shoot 'em up action. Manipulate the environment with control boxes, and make careful use of your shields to make it through seemingly impassable obstacles!

games.title: Iridis Alpha
games.description: It's a great pleasure to welcome gaming legend Jeff Minter to the Evercade library, and with one of his most interesting, creative and unusual games, too. Iridis Alpha challenges you to get blasting on two planets at once — can you handle the entropy?

games.title: Battle Valley
games.description: In Battle Valley, now for Evercade, it's your job to capture enemy bases using your tanks and helicopters. Work fast, though — the Doomsday clock is ticking, and the world is at stake!

games.title: Alleykat
games.description: The Alleykat racing championship is here, and you and your Evercade are invited! Strap yourself in for some high-velocity shooting action, and see if you can make enough in winnings to survive the whole season!

games.title: Street Sports Baseball
games.description: If you've ever felt that baseball could do with more concrete, then Street Sports Baseball for Evercade is here to provide. Take to the improvised field and play ball — just watch out for unexpected obstacles!

cartridges.title: Gaelco Arcade 2
cartridges.description: The Gaelco Arcade 2 cartridge for Evercade features 6 action-packed arcade games from Spanish developer Gaelco, featuring Big Karnak’s hack-and-slash fun, TH Strikes Back’s sci-fi platforming, World Rally 2’s high-speed racing, Maniac Square’s brain-bending puzzling, and competitive sporting action with Squash and Touch and Go!

games.title: Big Karnak
games.description: Big Karnak was one of Gaelco’s earliest, most popular games, and now you can enjoy it on Evercade! Hack and slash your way through ancient Egypt on a quest to rescue your wife!

games.title: TH Strikes Back: Thunder Hoop 2
games.description: In TH Strikes Back: Thunder Hoop 2, ten years have passed since the first Thunder Hoop. Genbreak is up to his old tricks, so it’s once again up to Thunder Hoop, now all grown up, to save the day. Enjoy this thrilling arcade hit, now for Evercade.

games.title: World Rally 2
games.description: World Rally 2, the visually spectacular follow-up to World Rally, brings more high-speed racing action to Evercade — this time with plenty of shortcuts to seek out, and much more varied courses to challenge!

games.title: Maniac Square
games.description: Maniac Square brings Gaelco’s take on the falling-block puzzler to Evercade. Match same-coloured blocks in lines of three or more horizontally, vertically or diagonally — and reach your quota before your time expires!

games.title: Squash
games.description: The high-speed racquet sport gets a rare video game adaptation with Gaelco’s simply named Squash, now for Evercade. Take to the court and outwit your opponent with your devious ball-bouncing manoeuvres!

games.title: Touch and Go
games.description: Touch and Go is a volleyball game by Gaelco, designed to be easy to learn but hard to master with its simple one-button controls. Play solo on the Evercade handheld, and compete or cooperate with a friend on Evercade VS.

cartridges.title: Jaleco Arcade 1
cartridges.description: The Jaleco Arcade 1 cartridge for Evercade features 8 great arcade games from Jaleco’s heyday in the ’80s and ’90s, including Rod Land, Saint Dragon, E.D.F. Earth Defense Force, Avenging Spirit, 64th Street: A Detective Story, Cybattler, P-47: The Phantom Fighter and The Astyanax

games.title: Rod Land
games.description: Jaleco’s super-cute elimination platformer Rod Land comes to Evercade! Save Rit and Tam’s mother from the Maboots Tower using the Rods of Sheesanomo and the Rainbow Shoes!

games.title: Saint Dragon
games.description: Take on a horde of cyborg monsters as Saint Dragon in this beloved Jaleco shoot 'em up for Evercade. Blast enemies with your fiery breath and protect yourself with your steel tail!

games.title: E.D.F. Earth Defense Force
games.description: Pick one of four powerful weapons and blast off against the enemy forces in E.D.F. Earth Defense Force, a classic Jaleco horizontally scrolling arcade shoot 'em up now available for your Evercade.

games.title: Avenging Spirit
games.description: In Avenging Spirit, you’re a ghost! Possess your enemies and use their abilities to fight back against your foes in Jaleco’s ghostly adventure for Evercade.

games.title: 64th Street: A Detective Story
games.description: 64th Street: A Detective Story is Jaleco’s prequel to its Rushing Beat series of beat 'em ups for home consoles. Now you can enjoy the original bone-crunching action on Evercade!

games.title: Cybattler
games.description: Cybattler is Jaleco’s multidirectional mecha shoot 'em up, now on your Evercade! Take control of the mighty “Blanche” and strike down the enemy forces with your cannons and sword!

games.title: P-47: The Phantom Fighter
games.description: In Jaleco’s horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up P-47: The Phantom Fighter, you’re battling for freedom! Take to the skies on your Evercade and turn the tide of World War II!

games.title: The Astyanax
games.description: The Astyanax is an action arcade game from Jaleco, now available for your Evercade. Take control of the warrior Roche and battle the demonic forces of the evil Argos!

cartridges.title: Intellivision Collection 2
cartridges.description: The Intellivision Collection 2 cartridge for Evercade features 12 beloved Intellivision games, including the legendary role-playing game Tower of Doom and classic dungeon crawler Cloudy Mountain.
cartridges.note: This cartridge is an Evercade Legacy Collection and is no longer in production.

games.title: Tower of Doom
games.description: The Intellivision’s ambitious action RPG Tower of Doom comes to your Evercade. Take on an ever-changing dungeon as you seek treasure, fame and glory. Read More...

games.title: Cloudy Mountain
games.description: Gather your party and venture forth as this classic Intellivision dungeon crawler comes to Evercade. Can you recover the Crown of Kings? Read More...

games.title: Hover Force
games.description: The Intellivision’s tactical top-down helicopter shooter comes to Evercade. Blast terrorists with your lasers — but don’t forget to put out the fires with your water cannon!

games.title: Star Strike
games.description: The Intellivision adaptation of a famous sci-fi movie’s best scene is here on your Evercade. Bomb the five exhaust ports before it’s too late — or the Earth is toast!

games.title: Vectron
games.description: The Intellivision’s most creative strategic shooter comes to Evercade. Build your energy base with multidirectional shooting — but watch out for the enemies hampering your efforts!

games.title: Auto Racing
games.description: Take to the circuit with this Intellivision racing classic for Evercade. Challenge your best times solo, or compete against a friend for points.

games.title: Stadium Mud Buggies
games.description: Hit the dirt with this varied Intellivision offroad racer for your Evercade. Compete in nine different events solo, against the computer or against a friend!

games.title: Motocross
games.description: Time for two-wheeled Intellivision mayhem on your Evercade. Challenge three different courses — or design your own with the built-in track editor!

games.title: Mountain Madness Super Pro Skiing
games.description: Take to the slopes with this challenging Intellivision sports title for your Evercade. Ski down 32 built-in courses, take on the randomly generated “Helicopter Skiing” mode — or make your own mountain!

games.title: Super Pro Decathlon
games.description: One to four can play in this Intellivision multi-sports extravaganza for Evercade. Take on ten challenging events and compete for the title of The Greatest Athlete in the World.

games.title: Sharp Shot
games.description: In this Intellivision classic for Evercade, you’ll use just one button to throw footballs, blast aliens, sink ships and protect your treasure from monsters!

games.title: Reversi
games.description: The classic board game comes to Evercade, Intellivision-style. Surround your opponent’s pieces and capture territory — remember to go for the corners!

cartridges.title: Morphcat Games Collection 1
cartridges.description: The Morphcat Games Collection 1 features 3 fantastic 8-bit indie games including Micro Mages, Böbl and Spacegulls, plus standalone expansion Micro Mages: Second Quest and the Super Bat Puncher Demo.

games.title: Micro Mages
games.description: Morphcat’s chaotic 8-bit action platformer comes to Evercade, with support for up to four players on Evercade VS! Can you and your fellow Micro Mages conquer the Demon Fortress?

games.title: Micro Mages: Second Quest
games.description: Micro Mages: Second Quest is a standalone expansion for Micro Mages, bringing an all-new 8-bit challenge for you and up to three friends to Evercade.

games.title: Böbl
games.description: In Böbl, you are an 8-bit bubble. Water is your friend and solid tiles will kill you! Challenge this unusual exploration-centric platformer on your Evercade and save the missing duckies!

games.title: Spacegulls
games.description: Spread your wings and fly in this 8-bit platformer for your Evercade. Can you track down your missing chicks and fend off Dr. Beak’s evil cyborg bird army?

games.title: Super Bat Puncher Demo
games.description: Morphcat’s classic 8-bit demo from 2011, now on your Evercade. Delve into the depths of planet BAT in search of the truth behind the explosive space bats that invaded the Earth!

cartridges.title: Gremlin Collection 1
cartridges.description: Six classic games from legendary British developer Gremlin, come to the Evercade with Gremlin Collection 1 including Zool, Actua Soccer, Hardcore 4X4, and more!

games.title: Actua Soccer
games.description: Actua Soccer comes to Evercade. The first of the Actua Series from Gremlin and one of the first 3D soccer simulations, and including commentary from the legendary Barry Davies.

games.title: Brain Bender
games.description: Bounce your laser beam around 120 levels in this challenging puzzler from Gremlin. Brain Bender brings 8-bit puzzle action from handhelds past to Evercade.

games.title: Hardcore 4X4
games.description: A full 3D Off-Road racing gem from Gremlin, Hardcore 4X4 brings all the thrills and spills of racing in treacherous conditions to your Evercade device.

games.title: Premier Manager 97
games.description: You’ve proven yourself on the field — but how will you do in the manager’s hot seat? Premier Manager 97 from Gremlin brings that addictive one more match feel to your Evercade!

games.title: Utopia: The Creation Of A Nation
games.description: Run the colony and prosper with Utopia: The Creation of a Nation. This great strategy game from Gremlin stands the test of time on Evercade -- but will you, as a leader? Read More...

games.title: Zool
games.description: The classic franchise from Gremlin, the ever-popular platformer Zool comes to Evercade in its 16-bit form.

cartridges.title: Renovation Collection 1
cartridges.description: Renovation Collection 1 brings 12 classic and rare 16-bit games to the Evercade, including Valis, Exile, Arcus Odyssey, Gaiares, Sol-Deace and more!

games.title: Arcus Odyssey
games.description: The followers of the evil sorceress Castomira have stolen the sword of Leaty, and it’s up to four brave Arcusians to get it back before Castomira is resurrected. Take on the role of swordsman Jedda, warrior maiden Erin, archer Diana or magician Bead and save the land from Darkness!

games.title: Beast Wrestler
games.description: The Life Science industries of the future have created the ultimate sports warriors: 25 feet tall and weighing several tons each, these gigantic wrestlers grapple for the ultimate championship!

games.title: Dino Land
games.description: Dino-Bunz thought he was a small and insignificant dinosaur — until, that is, he discovered he could roll himself into a ball and knock down the mightiest of dinosaurs. Now he must protect his sweetheart Meeshell from the gigantic, vicious and carnivorous predators who are out to get her!

games.title: El Viento
games.description: The scene is New York in 1928, and the worshippers of the ancient evil wind god Hastur are attempting to resurrect their deity. Only one woman can save the day: Annet, a distant relation of Hastur, and the only human capable of conquering the wicked god. But first she has to deal with Vincente DeMarco’s mob!

games.title: Exile
games.description: Sadler, hero of the desert, has once again been drawn into war as the nation of Luciel has launched an attack on his land. As our story begins, Sadler is gathering his elite troops and preparing for battle. Read More...

games.title: Final Zone
games.description: It is 100 years in the future, and you are ace New Age Power-Suit pilot Howie Bowie, leader of the “Undead” unit. You have been tasked with occupying and destroying Point A-46K Bloody Axis — the massive firepower of your NAP should make that a breeze, right?

games.title: Gaiares
games.description: The intergalactic terrorist group Gulfer is on the way to Earth to use our polluted waste to build weapons — and if they’re not stopped, Leezaluth, the governing empire of the galaxy, will supernova our sun to destroy them. It’s up to Dan Dare and his navigator Alexis to save the day!

games.title: Granada
games.description: The year is 2016. As sharpshooter Leon Todo, you will command the legendary Hypertek Cannon Tank Granada in battle as you attempt to uncover the truth behind the Private Enterprises’ Intelligence Department, or PEID.

games.title: Sol-Deace
games.description: It is the 33rd century, and humanity has been subjugated by a supercomputer named GCS-WT since 3,000 AD. Hoping to strike back against mankind’s mechanical overlords, Dr. Edwin Deace has developed a silver-white craft named Sol-Deace — and it’s up to you, your navigator Eric and your cannon commander Misao to take it into battle and liberate the Earth.

games.title: Traysia
games.description: Genre: RPG Players: 1 Roy is an 18 year old adventure-seeker who has left behind his hometown — and his childhood sweetheart Traysia. He has travelled to the Kingdom of Salon with his uncle to seek fame, fortune and adventure — but what trials await him on his journey? And what sort of person will he be when he finally returns to Traysia?

games.title: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier
games.description: Yuko Ahso is an average high school senior, who just happens to possess a heart completely balanced with equal parts of Yin and Yang. She has been chosen to wield the sword of Valis against the encroaching Darkness — and rescue her best friend Reiko from Rogles, King of the Dark Lords!

games.title: Valis III
games.description: Queen Valia of Dreamland has passed away, and her will revealed that Yuko Ahso, the Warrior of Valis, is actually one of her twin daughters. Moved by the knowledge of her true identity and the loss of her mother, Yuko sets out to restore peace to Dreamland forever.

cartridges.title: Intellivision Collection 1
cartridges.description: The Intellivision Collection 1 cartridge brings 12 classic Intellivision games to the Evercade! Including Astrosmash, Night Stalker, Frog Bog and more!
cartridges.note: This cartridge is an Evercade Legacy Collection and is no longer in production.

games.title: Astrosmash
games.description: Astrosmash is a frantic fixed shooter where you'll need to defend your planet from falling rocks, spinning missiles and UFOs. Keep blasting to build up that multiplier and reach the highest score you can!

games.title: Buzz Bombers
games.description: The bees are coming in Buzz Bombers! Blast the bees with your cans of bee repellent to turn them into honeycomb; when the hummingbird shows up, you'll get points for any honey he eats!

games.title: Frog Bog
games.description: In Frog Bog, you're a frog! Satisfy your froggy hunger by eating as many flies as you can in three minutes. Try all the different play modes for the ultimate amphibian challenge!

games.title: Night Stalker
games.description: You're trapped in a maze with no exits in Night Stalker — and the robots are coming for you! Grab the guns that someone has carelessly left lying around and fight to survive for as long as you can.

games.title: Pinball
games.description: Stand like a statue, become part of the machine, feel all the bumpers and always play clean. It's time to prove just how much of a pinball wizard you really are across three challenging screens!

games.title: Princess Quest
games.description: You are the brave Knight, and your childhood friend, the Princess, has been kidnapped by the Evil King from a neighbouring dark kingdom! Set off on your quest in Princess Quest to make things right and fight off every vicious monster in your way!

games.title: Shark! Shark!
games.description: It’s Shark! Shark! You're a fish and your goal is to eat other fish who are smaller than you to get bigger, but watch out for any fish who are bigger than you — along with the deadly shark, crab, lobsters and jellyfish.

games.title: Slap Shot Super Pro Hockey
games.description: Can you score more goals than your opponent? Take to the ice in Slap Shot Super Pro Hockey and prove your hockey dominance as either the Home Team or the Visiting Team!

games.title: Snafu
games.description: In Snafu, you must use your serpent to create a maze to corner your opponents... before you are cornered yourself! In Trap games, force your opponents to crash; in Bite games, nibble off your opponent's tail before they do the same to you!

games.title: Thin Ice
games.description: Duncan the penguin loves to skate on thin ice — and he loves to play pranks on other penguins, too. Skate all the way around each of Duncan's penguin friends to give them a surprise cold bath — but watch out for the polar bear and the seal!

games.title: Thunder Castle
games.description: As a brave knight in Thunder Castle, battle your way through the enchanted forest, the wizards' castle and the demons' dungeon to face your ultimate challenge!

games.title: Word Rockets
games.description: Letters are just letters until you make them words in Word Rockets! High in the sky, incomplete words float by. Quick, fill in the missing letters with your stock of vowels! How quickly can you make 50 words?

cartridges.title: Atari Arcade 1
cartridges.description: The Atari Arcade 1 cartridge brings 13 classic Atari arcade games to the Evercade, including: Liberator, Lunar Lander, Missile Command, Centipede, Asteroids, Pong and more!
cartridges.note: This is now an Evercade Legacy Collection and is no longer in production.

games.title: Asteroids
games.description: Enjoy one of the finest Arcade games of all time. Blast the never-ending streams of space rocks, but watch out for alien saucers! (Note this game is labeled Asteroids Deluxe, but plays as Asteroids).

games.title: Canyon Bomber
games.description: What good is a canyon if it's full of rocks? In Canyon Bomber you drop bombs from your blimp and your biplane into the canyon to clear up the mess — and do your best to score more points than your opponent while you're at it!

games.title: Centipede
games.description: Shoot all the segments of the Centipede as it descends the screen — but watch out for all the other hazards this perilous garden has to offer!

games.title: Crystal Castles
games.description: In Crystal Castles, the goal is to get the gems playing as Bentley Bear. Navigate your way through the evil Berthilda's 37 perilous castles and grab as many of the sparkling crystals as you can. But watch out — you're not the only one after the shinies!

games.title: Liberator
games.description: Commander Champion and the Atari Force need your help to free the galaxy from the evil Malaglon Army! In Liberator you command your fleet of ships to liberate a series of planets by destroying the Malaglon bases — but watch out for missiles!

games.title: Lunar Lander
games.description: There's a moon, and it's your job to land on it. You need to watch your speed in Lunar Lander and touch down on the craggy lunar surface safely as many times as you can to score the most points possible!

games.title: Millipede
games.description: Take on the role of The Archer as he attempts to defend his mushroom forest from gigantic insect monsters. Millipede is a follow-up to Centipede which offers faster, more challenging action for the real pro bug blasters!

games.title: Missile Command
games.description: The planet Zardon has always been a utopia, but their stellar neighbours on Krytolia are the jealous type. In Missile Command, you must save the planet by fending off the Krytolian barrage of missiles, satellites and bombs!

games.title: Night Driver
games.description: Night Driver was one of the first games to display real-time first person graphics. Put the pedal to the metal and drive as far as you can before time expires!

games.title: Pong
games.description: Created by Alan Alcorn as a training exercise assigned to him by Atari co-founder Nolan Bushnell, Pong went on to become the first commercially successful video game. And it's still one of the most competitive two-player games in the world

games.title: Skydiver
games.description: It's a lovely day to jump out of a plane and be a Skydiver, so that's exactly what you and a friend are going to do. The later you open your parachute, the more points you score — but keep an eye on the wind!

games.title: Super Breakout
games.description: Take on the challenge of the 1978 Arcade smash hit Super Breakout. Compete against an ever-advancing wall in Progressive mode, free two trapped balls in Cavity mode, or control two paddles at once in Double's multi-ball action!

games.title: Warlords
games.description: You are a warlord, and you're not at all happy about the other warlords who live nearby. Blast down your rivals' walls by deflecting the local dragon's fireballs with your shield!

cartridges.title: The Bitmap Brothers Collection 1
cartridges.description: The Bitmap Brothers Collection 1 cartridge brings 5 classic games from the British “rock star” developers to the Evercade, including: The Chaos Engine, Xenon 2: Megablast, Speedball and more!

games.title: The Chaos Engine
games.description: The year is 1887, and the steam-powered Chaos Engine has been causing mayhem across the world, bending time and space to its will. Now it's up to an elite strike force of mercenaries to destroy it once and for all.

games.title: Speedball
games.description: Step onto the steel-walled, steel-floored Speedball pitch and take on the challenge of this brutal future sport!

games.title: Speedball 2
games.description: Can you take Brutal Deluxe, the worst team in Speedball history, to the top of the leagues? Train your team, recruit star players and master the best ways to score in this cyberpunk sporting classic, Speedball 2.

games.title: Speedball 2100
games.description: It’s Speedball 2100, Brutal Deluxe are back for a whole new century — and once again it's up to you to take them from being the joke of the Speedball league to the number one spot.

games.title: Xenon 2: Megablast
games.description: Furious at their past failure to subjugate humanity, the Xenites have returned for revenge. And this time around, they've planted four Time Bombs throughout history, threatening to destroy the universe. Lucky you've got a time-travelling Megablaster spaceship then…

cartridges.title: Gaelco Arcade 1
cartridges.description: The Gaelco Arcade 1 cartridge brings 6 classic Gaelco arcade games to the Evercade, including: Alligator Hunt, World Rally, Thunder Hoop and more!

games.title: Alligator Hunt
games.description: Alligator Hunt’s premise is that reptilian aliens are invading the planet. Only one thing for it — time to hop on your skateboard and blast 'em away, then shoot off into space and take the fight to them!

games.title: Biomechanical Toy
games.description: In Biomechanical Toy, the evil criminal Scrubby has escaped — and what's worse, he's stolen the Magic Pendulum that brings toys to life! As the hero Inguz, fight your way through the land of toys and recover the Pendulum before it's too late.

games.title: Glass
games.description: In the story of Glass, a long time ago, aliens attacked us on Earth. Now it's our turn to fight back on their home planets — by stripping each stage of its layer of glass to uncover the unexpected and surprising secrets beneath!

games.title: Snowboard Championship
games.description: Are you ready for some extreme winter sports? Strap on your snowboard and take on the toughest challenges the mountain has to offer.

games.title: Thunder Hoop
games.description: Furious at his dismissal from the laboratories where he was carrying out his genetic research, Professor Daniel Genbreak has unleashed his evil creations on the world! Take on the role of human vaccine Thunder Hoop and destroy the Genbreak Virus once and for all.

games.title: World Rally
games.description: Hold tight for the ride of your life in World Rally. Gaelco's breakthrough hit puts you behind the wheel of a powerful rally car in the ultimate battle against the clock.

cartridges.title: Data East Arcade 1
cartridges.description: Featuring 10 classic arcade games from Data East, including Bad Dudes vs Dragon Ninja, Burger Time, Sly Spy, Dark Seal and more!

games.title: Bad Dudes vs. DragonNinja
games.description: It’s the Bad Dudes vs DragonNinjas. President Ronnie has been kidnapped by the ninjas. Are you a bad enough dude to rescue Ronnie? Of course you are; as the street-smart brawlers Blade and Striker, it's up to you to stop the spate of ninja-related crimes!

games.title: BreakThru
games.description: Those dastardly enemies have stolen your fancy PK430 aircraft and secured it 500 miles away from you! Fortunately, they left your high-tech assault vehicle completely intact. Time to Breakthru their defences and prove the folly of their ways!

games.title: Burger Time
games.description: In Burger Time, Peter Pepper needs your help to assemble some of the biggest burgers in the world — but Mr Hot Dog, Mr Pickle and Mr Egg have other ideas.

games.title: Chain Reaction
games.description: Grab pieces and match them in stacks of three in this frantic puzzler Chain Reaction. Face off against opponents in the Battle Mode, or take on the solo challenge to hone your skills!

games.title: Gate Of Doom (Dark Seal)
games.description: Gate of Doom casts you as one of four characters, commanded by the King of Etrulia, to save the realm from the evil Volov and his right hand man, the Black Knight. Taking place in a medieval fantasy world obviously inspired by Dungeons and Dragons.

games.title: Darwin 4078
games.description: Darwin 4078 is a shoot 'em up with a twist: you can evolve! Collect EVOL capsules to transform into one of 19 different forms, but watch out — some are easier to use than others!

games.title: Lock 'n' Chase
games.description: In Lock ‘n’ Chase, you're a thief! Break into the vault, grab the coins and nab any other treasure you can see — but watch out, because Stiffy, Scaredy, Smarty and Silly from the Super D security force are hot on your tail!

games.title: Sly Spy
games.description: The year is 199X, and the Council for World Domination is about to launch a nuclear missile. As Sly Spy, you're the only one who can stop this disaster, so leap into action and show those bad guys who's boss!

games.title: Tumblepop
games.description: It's time for some alien-chasing, mutant-busting, tumble-popping action! Suck up foes with your monster-bashing vacuum cleaner, then blast them back at enemies to clear out the stages.

games.title: Wizard Fire (Dark Seal II)
games.description: "The minions of evil will come, but they will be swept away by the Shining Knights of the Wizard Fire," sayeth the Sage. Guess who's in charge of those Shining Knights?

cartridges.title: Technos Arcade 1
cartridges.description: Featuring 8 classic arcade games from Technos including Double Dragon II: The Revenge, The Combatribes, Mysterious Stones: Dr John’s Adventure and more!
cartridges.note: This is now an Evercade Legacy Collection and is no longer in production.

games.title: Battle Lane Vol. 5
games.description: The fate of the country hangs in the balance in Battle Lane Vol. 5. Jump on your motorcycle and break through the enemy checkpoints with your machine gun, bazooka and driving skills!

games.title: Block Out
games.description: Block Out The 3D puzzler will baffle your brain and melt your mind! Looking down on a pit from above, you'll need to flip, turn, spin and move the falling blocks to form solid layers of cubes.

games.title: The Combatribes
games.description: In Combatribes, times are tough on the streets of New York City in the far-off future — and it's up to three cyborg vigilantes to clean up the town.

games.title: Double Dragon 2: The Revenge
games.description: Seeking revenge for their defeat by Billy and Jimmy Lee, the Black Warriors have shot Billy's girlfriend Marion to death. Double Dragon 2 pans across four missions and it's up to the brothers to exact their revenge!

games.title: Double Dragon 3: The Rosetta Stone
games.description: In Double Dragon 3, Billy and Jimmy Lee are approached by a mysterious fortune teller named Hiruko, who tells them that they must seek three mystical stones and unravel the mystery behind them. Thus begins a violent world tour!

games.title: Mania Challenge
games.description: In Mania Challenge you play as professional wrestler Dynamite Tommy. The time has come for you to face off against the fierce fighters of the TWF. Can you prove yourself in the ring and win the title belt, or are you doomed to be forgotten?

games.title: Minky Monkey
games.description: Follow the monkey's instructions and take the fruit up or down the ropes to score successes — but watch out for that mischievous Minky Monkey, who wants the fruit for himself!

games.title: Mysterious Stones
games.description: Dr John (no, not that one) is on a mission to uncover the lost treasure of various crypts around the world, and it's up to you to help him! Find the Mysterious Stones, and you might just get rich. Read More...

cartridges.title: Mega Cat Studios Collection 2
cartridges.description: The Mega Cat Studios Collection 2 cartridge brings 8 more classic Mega Cat Studios games to the Evercade! Great independent titles such as Roniu’s Tale, Yazzie, Misplaced, Arkagis Revolution and more!
cartridges.note: This is now an Evercade Legacy Collection and is no longer in production.

games.title: Alter Ego
games.description: Blessed — or perhaps cursed — with a phantom twin, you find yourself trapped in a strange void, with the only means of escape being to collect the shining red gems. Swap places with your alter ego to reach new places.

games.title: Arkagis Revolution
games.description: The year is 2612, and the Martian nation of Arkagis is heavily contested. As Lyn, an Arkagian rebel with no desire to live either under the previous dictatorship or the rule of the United Space Colonies, it’s time to fight back against oppression with the power of the ARX-01 spaceship.

games.title: Devwill Too
games.description: In Devwill Too, you are a homunculus on the search for the meaning behind your existence. Take on your own existential journey into the nature of being in this peculiar platformer!

games.title: Gluf
games.description: Gluf the electric frog is on a quest to power up the world! Charge up on the charging station to power up your surge meter, power all the tiles in each stage and escape through the door to continue on your way!

games.title: Misplaced
games.description: Every day, Hara wakes up on a strange, small island in the clouds. Can you help him unravel the mystery of the sky world? Use your dimensional powers of recording and playback to return the red crystals to their altars and reveal the magic keys!

games.title: Romeow and Julicat
games.description: Romeow loves Julicat, and the best way for him to prove that is by playing his instruments and singing his songs! Help him do just that by placing as many pieces on the puzzle board as you can.

games.title: Roniu's Tale
games.description: Trapped in a dungeon with only a ghost girl for company, Roniu must collect all the orbs and make a wish in order to escape. But will he be able to save his spectral friend too? Find out in this puzzle adventure where the floor collapses behind you with every step you take.

games.title: Yazzie
games.description: Treasure hunter Yazzie Goldsmith has come to a mysterious old mansion in search of the golden treasures rumoured to be within. But the mansion is full of many dangers… and devious puzzles to solve!

cartridges.title: Codemasters Collection 1
cartridges.description: The Codemasters Collection 1 Cartridge for Evercade; 17 of the most renowned games in British gaming history including Sensible Soccer, Cannon Fodder, Linus Spacehead, and an unreleased title, Tennis All-Stars.
cartridges.note: This is now an Evercade Legacy Collection and is no longer in production.

games.title: Bee 52
games.description: The Really Nice Honey company depends almost exclusively on one black and yellow striped worker: the one and only Bee 52! Gather nectar from the flowers, turn it into honey at the hive and stop the ants from stealing your precious product!

games.title: Big Nose Freaks Out
games.description: One Tuesday in 17 million BC, Bignose the caveman was jumped on by Leroy the Lizardman, and all his bones were stolen before he could store them in the bank! Hop on Bignose’s newly invented stoneboard, recover those bones and teach Leroy a lesson he’ll never forget.

games.title: Big Nose the Caveman
games.description: Big Nose the Caveman’s village is starving and Thanksgiving is just around the corner, so it’s up to our hero to find some food. That passing pterodactyl looks like it might be tasty, but there are four islands of adventure between Bignose and a hearty dinner!

games.title: Boomerang Kid
games.description: Abandoned by his parents on a camping trip to the Australian outback, Boomerang Kid quickly learned to survive in the wild with the help of the indigenous people. When their store is raided, Boomerang Kid swears to pay them back for their kindness by tracking down every single stolen boomerang!

games.title: CJ's Elephant Antics
games.description: Somewhere over France, turbulence hits the plane carrying Columbus Jumbo the elephant to the zoo, causing his cage to break open. Seeing an opportunity to escape, CJ grabs a nearby umbrella, leaps out of the plane and begins his long trek back to Africa!

games.title: Cannon Fodder
games.description: War has never been so much fun in Cannon Fodder! In this squad-based action-strategy title, you’ve got 360 eager recruits ready to take on 24 challenging missions. Can you lead them to victory?

games.title: Cosmic Spacehead
